paragraphs: These novels were bestsellers on other major platforms. The 200,000 dollars was the post-tax royalty share, with all types of taxes already deducted. There was even a tax payment certificate, meaning not even a ghost could find fault with it.
The System stated that all big data had been pre-processed, and all contracts were recorded in black and white, so the money was especially clean.
"Not even beggars would write online novels!!!"
Luis slept soundly. The next morning, Lily went out carefully so as not to wake her husband. When he woke up, it was already noon, and no one was home.

The Mother In Law had probably left early because she was acting coy again after sobering up. Luis was curious about his sister in law Nancy’s lazy nature—how could she, who loved sleeping until noon, be up so early?
Luis lay lazily in bed, took out his phone, and saw that some information had been updated.
"Daniel, you bastard, what’s wrong with me using the car? My name is on the license too."
"Nancy, stop making such a fuss. It’s true your name is on it, but did you pay for it?"
"You took my BMW to let your mom practice driving. Are you insane? Now it’s all scratched up. Do you even have the money to fix it?"
"And what’s with the paint on the door yesterday? ’Repay your debts’? What’s that about?"
"How should I know? I owe credit card debt, and credit card companies don’t do this. Maybe you’ve incurred gambling debts somewhere else?"
Nancy clearly said this out of guilt and probably had a guess about who did it.
"Don’t play dumb. Those online loan companies have been calling me nonstop, several times a day. What are you going to do about all the money you owe?"
"Bullshit! You enjoyed spending it too. Where do you think that PS4 came from?"
"Give me a break. Your cosmetics, beauty memberships, and gym cards—did I use any of that?"
"Nancy, I’m telling you, the calls have reached my dad. You’d better explain yourself. I don’t have the money to cover your losses if you keep spending like this."
"I have no money. At most, I can sell my gold jewelry."
"Are you kidding me? You already sold it once! What you have left isn’t even worth 5,000 dollars??"
Wow, it seemed Nancy was no ordinary spendthrift. When she used to show off, a set of cosmetics could easily cost thousands, and a lipstick costing over a thousand was normal.

As for the gold jewelry, when she got married, all of Daniel’s relatives gave gold as gifts. Luis remembered her saying it was worth at least over 10,000 dollars, but she had already sold most of it, leaving only about 5,000 dollars’ worth.
"I don’t care. You go get it back for me."
"You tell my mom yourself. I can’t bring myself to ask. Also, tell those debt collectors to stop calling me."
The conversation ended there. After looking at the information collected by the System, Luis understood the general situation.

The high-end apartment they used as their wedding home was bought a long time ago and was registered under Daniel’s name alone. The renovation was paid for by Daniel’s parents, and the mortgage was also being repaid by his parents.
This couple, who lived off their parents, were idle and spent money lavishly. They were utterly wasteful.
Daniel’s wedding was a grand affair that drained his family’s savings. But the gold jewelry given was so meager because Daniel was heavily in debt from gambling at the time.

Even though his parents worked hard to fill the hole of tens of thousands of dollars, it was still very difficult for the young couple to rely on their parents after marriage. They lived a carefree life using credit cards.
At the beginning of the year, there was a wave of thefts in their apartment building, so the couple decided to store the remaining gold jewelry in the safe of Daniel’s parents.
In other words, Nancy, who appeared to be living a prosperous life, now only had gold jewelry worth 5,000 dollars and half of a second-hand domestic BMW left...
God’s perspective was so satisfying. After Luis’s analysis, he realized his sister in law was almost at her wit’s end.
The pile of debts was already in a terrible state, and now, with the involvement of the Nova Media contract, it immediately became a perfect opportunity to take advantage of the situation.
Luis was mentally jolted awake and immediately looked at the other information collected by the System.
Among it was material related to Nova Media, likely a call intercepted from the boss’s phone:
"This Nancy, damn it, the more I think about it, the more unwilling I feel to let it go. With her looks and figure, once I drag her into this, I dare to quote over ten thousand per night."
"These days, married women are still very popular."
"Notify the lawyer, speed up the prosecution. The moment the lawsuit is filed, enforce it immediately."
"If she gives me attitude, this time I will definitely make her life miserable and ruin her reputation completely."
With this information, Luis felt even more confident. He had no idea what Nancy was up to. She couldn’t possibly have the guts to ask her parents-in-law for those gold jewelry pieces back, could she?
Before, she had always complained about them being gifts from elders, calling them old-fashioned and tacky. Now, she probably couldn’t even explain the fact that she was buried in debt.
Birds of a feather flock together—this couple was constantly drowning in debt. Daniel’s parents probably couldn’t take it anymore.
He continued playing dumb, waiting for her to come to him on her own. Luis quickly formulated a strategy: make Nancy crack under the pressure until she had no choice but to ask him for help.
"Ten Thousand dollars? Nancy, why do you..."
"Sister Minnie, I really need it for something urgent."
"How could I possibly have that much money? I just bought a new bag and I’m still in debt myself."
As soon as that call ended, another recording played.
"Dexter..."
Luis was puzzled, wondering who this bastard was. But then he seemed to recall Lily mentioning that he might be the sister-in-law’s first love.
"Nancy, you’re finally paying attention to me. I told you, no matter whether you’re married or not, I will always love you the most."
"I don’t love her—it was an arranged marriage by my family. As long as you’re willing, I still love you the most."
Damn it, this guy sounded like a seasoned player, probably looking to fool around with someone else’s wife without taking any responsibility. What a legend among men.
Nancy Yao’s voice trembled with emotion as she spoke again, "Dexter, I... I have something I need to ask for your help with."
"As long as it’s your matter, no matter how small, I would go through fire and water for you..."
His tone was overflowing with righteous passion.
"I want to borrow Ten thousand dollars from you. I’ve recently..."
Before she could even finish, Dexter cut her off, "Nancy, I want to help you, but my hands are tied."
"I just bought a house and have no money left. My salary card is with my wife. I’m struggling myself right now..."
"Then could you try to think of a way..."
"My kid is crying, that’s it!!"

Nancy made several calls but failed to borrow any money. Even at this point, she still didn’t dare ask her in-laws for the jewelry back, nor did she dare borrow from other relatives or friends for fear of being laughed at.
Of course, the main reason was that she was afraid she wouldn’t be able to borrow anything at all. After all, she knew exactly what kind of relatives she had.
"Dad!!"
What Luis hadn’t expected was that she even called her father-in-law, Arthur, cautiously explaining that she was short on money recently and wanted to borrow some.

"I am still begging left and right for this year’s project payments. I’m even planning to sell my car—how could I have any spare cash? I was actually hoping you could talk to your parents-in-law about it."
"You’re already married. If you’re facing difficulties, you should discuss it with them."
"They’re salaried workers with savings. They don’t even spend their own money on food and drinks."
"Please do Dad a favor and ask them about this. When you got married, we didn’t ask for any betrothal gifts. They should remember that."

This phone call would absolutely crush Nancy’s hopes, because Arthur worked in construction engineering. His life had been comfortable in previous years, but now it was clear he was also struggling financially.

He had always been old-fashioned and biased toward sons over daughters, believing that a married daughter was like water spilled on the ground, gone forever. He believed Nancy should take her problems to her in-laws.
Most importantly, he was also a man who cared deeply about face. The fact that he had resorted to asking his daughter’s in-laws for money proved that his own situation was dire.
Luis couldn’t help but feel a sense of schadenfreude. His sister-in-law was probably at the end of her rope now. It all depended on how that Anglo would choose to kick her while she was down.
After thinking for a moment, Luis called Nancy Yao and asked, "Elder Sister, where are you?"
"Drinking coffee at the mall!!"
Nancy’s voice sounded weak and utterly dejected.
"I’m coming to see you. There’s something I need your cooperation with."

What Luis hadn’t expected was that she even called her father-in-law, Arthur, cautiously explaining that she was short on money recently and wanted to borrow some.
"I am still begging left and right for this year’s project payments.
I’m even planning to sell my car—how could I have any spare cash?
I was actually hoping you could talk to your parents-in-law about it."
"You’re already married.
If you’re facing difficulties, you should discuss it with them."
"They’re salaried workers with savings.
They don’t even spend their own money on food and drinks."
"Please do Dad a favor and ask them about this.
When you got married, we didn’t ask for any betrothal gifts.
They should remember that."
This phone call would absolutely crush Nancy’s hopes, because Arthur worked in construction engineering.
His life had been comfortable in previous years, but now it was clear he was also struggling financially.
He had always been old-fashioned and biased toward sons over daughters, believing that a married daughter was like water spilled on the ground, gone forever.
He believed Nancy should take her problems to her in-laws.
Most importantly, he was also a man who cared deeply about face.
The fact that he had resorted to asking his daughter’s in-laws for money proved that his own situation was dire.
Luis couldn’t help but feel a sense of schadenfreude.
His sister-in-law was probably at the end of her rope now.
It all depended on how that Anglo would choose to kick her while she was down.
After thinking for a moment, Luis called Nancy Yao and asked, "Elder Sister, where are you?"
"Drinking coffee at the mall!!"
Nancy’s voice sounded weak and utterly dejected.
"I’m coming to see you.
There’s something I need your cooperation with."

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Chilled Nancy
paragraphs: "Nancy, it is not that I do not want to help you, but our crew bonuses have been stopped, and performance bonuses are the same."

"You should understand the situation. The losses from the pandemic are so massive that we dare not publicly report them. We are at least fortunate to receive a basic salary. I heard some unlucky individuals have not received a single penny for three months."
"Nancy, stop joking. My mortgage payments for that unfinished building have halted. I do not even have the funds to sue the developer now, so how could I possibly lend you money?"
"Nancy, what a rare guest... My restaurant, damn it, closed down long ago. I am currently job hunting."
"I cannot lend money, but I can offer you my life. I am a tour guide who has not worked in ages. Now buried in debt, I have no idea who to borrow from."
Nancy’s face was etched with worry, her hands painfully massaging her temples.
She had finally swallowed her pride and asked her classmates for loans. As a flight attendant major, half her classmates were either flight attendants or worked in the railways.
On ordinary days, her social media feeds were filled with luxury hotels, designer clothes and handbags, frequent check-ins at famous tourist spots—each portraying a glamorous, high-society image.
But after asking around, she discovered it was all just a facade; they were as penniless as she was.
If it were merely excuses, that would be one thing, but even her close friends, those who knew her intimately and were aware of her private circumstances, could only offer helpless, bitter smiles:
"Don’t even bring it up. Nina got caught last time she went out with a man. 200 dollars a night is so not worth it."

"Don’t even think about borrowing from Lindi. She’s poorer than anyone right now. The hotel owner who used to keep her went bankrupt and is broke. Now she can’t find a new sponsor to take over, and she can’t even pay her mortgage."

"Quinn, don’t be fooled by her always flaunting that shabby BMW. Her sugar daddy ran off. She just started working at a nightclub last month, and what she earns now isn’t enough to cover her previous debts."
"Do you know how corrupt it is? If you don’t offer full services, no one wants you. If you do, after commissions, management fees, and costume charges, you only get 160 dollars a night."
"Damn it, I’m being honest with you, I went for an interview. They said I’d only make half of what Lindi does, and she’s the top earner there, and that’s all she gets."
After making inquiries, Nancy felt increasingly disheartened. The flight attendant profession, though not large, was predominantly female and had always been a melting pot.
Being kept as a mistress or selling one’s body was so common it wasn’t even news anymore. On the contrary, those who remained pure were a rarity.

If you were lucky enough to snag a rich second-generation heir, you could marry him. If unlucky, you had to dive into the world of pleasure. Many of her flight attendant classmates even picked up passengers on planes and rented rooms to sell themselves at their destinations.
What chilled Nancy most was Lindi. Proud as a peacock, she had actually ended up in a nightclub.
You must understand, though this major was niche in school, it was packed with beauties and intensely competitive. Lindi was a school belle whose looks and figure were on par with Nancy’s.
She had already entered the sex industry. Nancy’s head spun, remembering her classmate’s words.

"Prices are generally low now. I heard from other classmates that there are at least twice as many girls in nightclubs as customers. The competition is so fierce some are undercutting prices, leaving even less money for the girls."
"If you want to do it, ask Lindi for help. She currently commands the highest price. If you go, you can definitely get the same rate as her."
Although classmates didn’t discuss these things in group chats, sticking to gossip and boasts, the underground market realities were clear for all to see.
Some classmates even asked Nancy if she had any sponsors to introduce, not minding sharing a bed, imagine how desperate their finances were.
It’s easy to adapt to luxury, but hard to return to simplicity. On the surface, everyone appeared radiant and stylish in designer clothes, but in reality, they were all dirt poor.

Selling one’s body isn’t even easy now. The flight attendant title doesn’t add much to the price, and finding a sponsor is tough. Even school beauties are forced into nightclubs. You can imagine how terrible the economic environment is.
"How could this be!"
Nancy’s scalp tingled with dread. Weren’t five-star nightclubs supposed to charge four to five thousand dollars for a full night? How come the girls only get 160 dollars?

By that calculation, if she sold herself daily, skipping her period, she’d only make a little over 3,000 dollars a month. Even without eating or drinking, she couldn’t pay off her debts in half a year.
Selling herself... that would mean complete ruin, especially since she was a married woman.
Truthfully, Nancy’s situation was somewhat laughable. Relying on her school belle beauty and figure, she had always been arrogant, believing she looked better than others even without makeup.

So she acted haughtily in school, failing to notice that some classmates had started using designer bags early on or had sugar daddies picking them up in cars. She was utterly living in her own world.
If any classmate had bragged to her excessively, or if some wealthy man had made a move, she wouldn’t have ended up marrying that fake rich second-generation, Daniel.
"Big sister!"
When Luis approached, his eyes lit up.
His sister-in-law Nancy had tied up her long, wavy hair, adding a touch of restrained allure. With delicate, light makeup, she looked exceptionally beautiful.
She wore a casual lace short-sleeved top and denim shorts that accentuated her long, captivating legs.
Though she wore no jewelry, her elegance was undeniable. Clearly, her flight attendant training hadn’t been in vain. Sitting there, she was stunningly beautiful, drawing everyone’s attention.
There was no greater beauty in the world. Compared to her mother-in-law’s mature fullness, Nancy was in the prime of her youth—the most beautiful age for a woman, like a flower blooming perfectly.
What a pity that Daniel, that piece of trash, had taken advantage of her.
"Brother-in-law, what would you like to drink?"
Nancy perked up, smiling like an orchid. "I was so drunk last night I forgot how I got back to my room. Luckily, I didn’t vomit, or I would have troubled you."
How could she be sure she hadn’t vomited? Because Nancy either slept naked or only in underwear. She had woken up in the middle of the night parched with thirst.
Vaguely remembering her clothes were still on, but finding them cumbersome and uncomfortable, she had taken off her nightgown and bra, drunk some water, and fallen back into a deep sleep.
She could clearly determine that Luis had not done anything to her nor taken any advantage.

On the contrary, thinking about the glass of water by her bed in the middle of the night filled her heart with warmth the next morning. She hadn’t expected this man to be so considerate despite being so drunk himself. Her jealousy towards her sister surged once again.
"You really didn’t vomit. You couldn’t even walk straight last night, okay? I carried you back to your room."
Luis stated this very calmly.
Nancy’s face flushed slightly. She smiled and said, "That must have been exhausting. I haven’t been dieting lately, and my weight keeps climbing."
"Elder sister, you have a tall figure. A little curves make you look good both front and back. If you were just a stick, it wouldn’t be attractive."
Women always appreciate such compliments. The more she looked at her brother-in-law, the more she liked him, temporarily setting aside her suppressed negative emotions.
"By the way, what did you need from me?"
"I need your cooperation, elder sister. We can perform a double act."
Luis said with a chuckle, "Didn’t you say you were going to buy Mom a car last time? It happens to be her birthday soon, so I want to surprise her. That’s why I need your help today."
"How can I help?"

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Is He Your Husband?
paragraphs: Thinking of the huge amount of money in Luis’s stock account and hearing from her sister that he had a lot of investments and had already achieved financial freedom, Nancy felt her heart pounding and began to have strange thoughts in her mind.

The sponsors that the students were trying their best to find were all middle-aged ugly men. If there was a young, rich, and somewhat handsome sponsor like this, she was afraid they would fight for him.
"Let’s go look at cars together. You are nominally the customer, and the car will be in your name first. We can transfer it to her when it’s time to give it to her for her birthday."

Luis wanted to experiment. He nominally gave the car to his mother in law, but the money was registered under the name of his eldest sister in law Nancy. He wanted to see if the task would include the money in her account.
"Why make it so much trouble?"

Nancy felt a little guilty for a moment. She was now in debt and did not know what to do. The matter with Nova Media was probably not over yet. It might not be appropriate to have another car in her name at this time.

"Sister, you forgot I used to work at a car repair shop. There are a lot of unspoken rules in our industry. There are kickbacks from the car repair shop and from acquaintances who bring them to 4S stores to buy cars. Of course, this money does not flow to outsiders."
"Besides, I will pretend to be a car mechanic and take you there. I can check the interior and other configurations, and I can tell whether they are original car parts or not."
"Kickbacks, a lot?"
"2% is generally the industry rate. I just asked and it is still the same."
Nancy wanted to refuse but she did not dare to tell the truth, and she could not think of any other excuse. After all, the car was to be given to her biological mother.
Luis handed her one of his bank cards and said, "The password is six eights. You can use this one when you swipe the card later."
"Good!"
Nancy thought that it was just a car and there should not be any problems. Besides, Luis said that he would buy one to practice first, so he should buy a cheap second hand car.
Nancy was completely dumbfounded when Luis stopped a taxi and took her to the Porsche dealership.
Just as Luis was about to step in, she grabbed his hand and said in a panic, "Brother in law, you want to buy a Porsche?"
"Yeah, let us do it right away, so that those gossipy women will not have to show off in front of Mom all day long."
Luis said with a smile, "Do not worry, big sister, I can afford it if I can buy it. I will pay for the maintenance of the car, so you do not have to worry about it.
Luis pulled her into the store. sales manager greeted her warmly. Luis extended his hand and said with a smile, "Hello, Manager Blanche, nice to see you again."
"Hello, Luis!"
They shook hands and said everything.
Luis had spoken to her on the phone before, and they discussed the situation and agreed on the amount of kickbacks. This was not groundless.

Many people like to bring a knowledgeable relative with them when buying a car, whether it is a new car or a used car, or directly ask a familiar mechanic to help them with the inspection or check the condition of the car.

Car dealerships are accustomed to this. Even if there is no prior communication before bringing a large number of professional technicians, they can still get it done with a brief private discussion when they meet.

After all, from the customer’s perspective, they will definitely trust their acquaintances or relatives more, and will listen to their opinions more if they do not understand something when buying a car. Therefore, this group of intermediary people are also valuable resources for stores.
They may even advise you to buy a used car instead of a new one.
When it comes to complaining, people say that this brand is not as good as that brand, and they always have a lot of say.
"What would you two like to drink?"
Manager Blanche asked with a smile on her face.
"Coffee, thank you."
Nancy just finished speaking when she suddenly grabbed her hand in surprise, "Teacher Blanche, it is you!"
"Nancy!"
Manager Blanche’s eyes lit up as well, and she said with a sweet smile, "I did not recognize you. Come and sit down."

After that, they started chatting intimately. Luis was stunned watching from the side. He found out that she was the physical education teacher of their school, who was working part time here because of the bad job situation.
"Nancy has made great progress and is now buying a Cayenne.
The mature and charming Blanche sighed.

She knew better than anyone how chaotic the school was, but this group of people always laughed at the poor but not at prostitutes, and she would be laughed at by everyone if she suffered with the poor boy.

If you find a big money sponsor, you will be worshipped by everyone. It does not matter whether this sponsor is old, ugly, or rich. It is okay. There are few people who look glamorous on the surface but actually live a good life.
As she spoke, she looked puzzled, because Nancy did not have any branded clothes on her, her bag was very ordinary, and she did not even wear any jewelry. She did not even have the most basic outfit.
Fortunately, Nancy had the conditions and temperament to do so. After a brief moment of panic, she smiled and said, "Teacher, we have to buy a car to get around."
"Okay, it is a blessing for the teacher. I have not opened a shop for a long time."
Teacher Blanche pondered for a moment, then lowered her head and asked, "Where did you find this boy?"
Seeing Nancy’s hesitation, teacher Xiao opened her eyes wide and said, "Is it your husband?"
"No, teacher, that..."
Nancy waved her hand hesitantly for a moment.
Teacher Blanche showed an understanding expression and said with a smile, "We will talk about it later. Take a look at the car first."
Blanche held the materials and followed along, also bringing over two cups of iced coffee.

Luis was chatting animatedly with the technician from the Store around a Cayenne, discussing everything from the configuration to potential issues with licensed vehicles in a highly professional manner.
Nancy looked somewhat puzzled at Teacher Blanche, who chuckled and pulled her to sit down in the nearby reception area.
"Teacher, you don’t seem very professional," Nancy teased with a smile. "This is the first time I’ve seen a salesperson who knows nothing about what they’re selling."
"Salespeople don’t really understand these details. It’s mainly because the person you brought is too professional," Teacher Blanche lowered her voice and said.
"Let me tell you, the salespeople here are just like those in real estate sales offices—they work on commission with no base salary, so very few of them are truly knowledgeable."

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Does Lily Know About This?
paragraphs: Their flight attendant group often posted these kinds of part-time job opportunities. They considered themselves a cut above the rest, looking down on roles like event hostesses and feeling such part-time jobs weren’t prestigious enough.
These kinds of part-time gigs usually appeared at property openings or during peak sales seasons for high-end cars.
The main appeal was the elevated status and the chance to mingle with wealthy crowds, potentially landing a rich husband or a generous sugar daddy.
The commissions were decent, but making money often came with being taken advantage of. If the price was right, many wouldn’t mind a fleeting romance to help things along.
"Teacher, how are you doing with it?" Nancy asked instinctively.

Aside from turning to prostitution or being kept, these were two of the quickest ways to make money. At least whether one lost their virtue depended on their mood, though anyone not prepared to be taken advantage of had better not bother.
"Just getting by!" Teacher Blanche suddenly said with a suggestive look. "Nancy, honestly, I’ve seen your wedding photos. This isn’t your husband, is it?"
"How could you tell?" Nancy retorted.
"Your husband looks thin, bony, and not very tall. This guy is at least half a head taller than you, and though he looks lean, he probably has muscle."
"Not to mention, the more you look at him, the more pleasing he becomes. He isn’t even dressed up—with a little effort, he’d definitely be handsome."

While they were gossiping, Luis and the technician had already driven the car to the back for inspection. Licensed display cars were one thing, but test-drive vehicles were another—every detail had to be scrutinized.

"So professional!" Teacher Blanche narrowed her eyes. "Nancy, I’ve seen plenty of half-informed relatives tag along, and I’ve seen professional mechanics help with car purchases, but none of them were like him."
Nancy replied somewhat guiltily, "What’s different about him?"

Teacher Blanche smiled. "It’s definitely different. Clearly, you’re the one buying the car, yet he’s inspecting everything so meticulously. It’s obvious he’s the one interested in the Cayenne. An ordinary mechanic wouldn’t be this fussy."
"Besides, your husband didn’t come with you to buy the car!"
Teacher Blanche examined her with a knowing smile. "Nancy, your relationship with this mechanic doesn’t seem like just ordinary friends."
"What’s the issue?"
"Ordinary friends wouldn’t care this much."
"And even though you’re the one buying the car, he hasn’t once asked for your opinion. It’s clear he’s the one calling the shots."
Blanche’s gaze was sharp. She took Nancy’s hand and said playfully, "I’m not an outsider. You don’t have to hide it from me, I’ve seen everything. Does this guy know you’re married?"
"He knows!" Nancy’s mind was in turmoil, and she truly didn’t know how to explain.
Teacher Blanche’s expression was unmistakably suggestive. If she tried to explain that this was her brother-in-law, it would only make things messier and more open to interpretation.
"Oh, can’t believe someone so young is into playing with married women."
Teacher Blanche chuckled and said, "That boy looks about your age, probably even younger than you. Nancy, you’re quite the cougar feasting on young grass, and you’ve taken it to a whole new level."
Nancy is only a year older than Luis. The misconception might stem from her dressing in a sexy, mature style, while Luis maintains the casual, relaxed attire of a young man.
"Teacher, stop talking nonsense!"
"What nonsense? In a normal relationship, who would just buy you a car out of the blue and a Cayenne at that?"
Teacher Blanche lowered her voice and said, "Don’t worry, I won’t tell your husband. I don’t even know him, right? There’s nothing to be ashamed of admitting.
The more she tried to explain, the worse it sounded. Nancy was sweating bullets, unsure how to respond.
"Alright, he’s here now, so let’s drop it for the moment. I’ll reach out to you later."
Just then, Luis walked over. He’d been under the car, so his face and hands were smudged with oil and dust, and even his clothes were stained in ways that wouldn’t wipe off easily.
"Sister Nancy, the car’s fine it’s a brand-new display model. I’ve checked everything, and the odometer hasn’t even been activated yet."
Teacher Blanche squinted with a smile. "Quite the professional. Of course the car’s in perfect condition. Why would I cheat my own student, right?"
"Exactly. It’s fate that you two ran into each other like this."
Luis bantered with her for a bit before heading to the office with Nancy, who seemed to be in a daze.
"This is a mid-tier model, and all the licensing procedures are already handled. We just need your documents to process the ownership transfer. Our staff will take care of all the details."

Teacher Blanche picked up the documents and explained smoothly, "The price has been negotiated down to the minimum 101,000. The down payment would be 40,000, and the mortgage rate from our partner bank is—"
"Full payment."
Luis cut in, "The interest on a mortgage is ridiculously expensive."
"That means a smaller commission. Sister Nancy, you ought to give your teacher a gift later to make up for it."
Teacher Blanche paused, then shot Nancy a deeply suggestive look.
Her eyes seemed to say, Keep playing dumb. Who decides whether to pay in full or get a mortgage when buying a car? What kind of car inspector has that kind of authority? You can’t fool me.
"Why would the commission be lower if we pay in full?"
Nancy asked guiltily, avoiding eye contact.

"When it comes to car sales, the commission for a full payment is only slightly higher than for a mortgage, almost negligible. Compared to the bonuses banks give for arranging mortgages, it’s night and day."
Teacher Blanche laughed teasingly. "This young man is really thoughtful, so considerate."
Luis smiled faintly. "You’re too kind, Teacher. Wouldn’t want you to lose out, right?"
"Any woman with you is lucky, that’s for sure."
Teacher Blanche smiled meaningfully, then asked Nancy to hand over her card. But after rummaging through her bag, Nancy frowned and said, "I—I think I left my card at the café."
Teacher Blanche was instantly embarrassed, and the finance staff froze too, wondering if this plainly dressed couple was just wasting their time.
"We can look for it later. If it’s really lost, we’ll just report it."
Luis shook his head, pulled out another card from his wallet, and handed it over. "Use this one."
"Of course!"

Teacher Blanche immediately beamed and bustled about enthusiastically. Nancy was stunned, her card was left at the café, but her brother-in-law’s other card actually had enough to cover the full price of a Cayenne.
Financial freedom... How much money does he actually have?
Teacher Blanche suddenly produced a wet wipe and handed it to Nancy. "Where are your manners? Help him clean up.
Only then did Nancy snap out of it. Turning, she saw smudges of dust and black oil on Luis’s face, clearly from when he’d crawled under the car earlier.
"Look how attentive he is. You—you should appreciate what you have."
Under the teacher’s suggestive gaze, Nancy didn’t bother explaining and simply began wiping Luis’s face. They were all adults, and this wasn’t exactly an intimate or ambiguous act.
Seeing she’d finally come around, Teacher Blanche smiled and handed her the whole pack of wet wipes, fanning the flames further. "Nancy, you’re something else. Always so careless that won’t do."
Nancy rolled her eyes, knowing exactly what she meant, and continued wiping Luis’s arms.
Luis enjoyed his sister-in-law’s ministrations without a hint of guilt. One look at Teacher Blanche’s expression told him everything. If she isn’t explaining, why should I?
The moment 101,000 was swiped, the System suddenly dinged.
"Ongoing Mission: The Tall, Sexy Sister-in-Law... Strategy in progress, cutting corners, exploiting opportunities..."
Luis’s breath hitched. Then the System announced, "For strategic purposes, the amount is approved. Current total: 101,000."
In an instant, Luis jumped up and cheered, unable to contain his joy. He never expected the System to be this accommodating—even allowing loopholes.
Right then, he felt like kissing whoever was nearest. Everyone around was startled by his outburst, and Nancy looked completely bewildered.
"Sorry, sorry! I just didn’t expect things to go so smoothly!!!"
After payment, the paperwork was quickly completed. The car was registered under Nancy’s name, all that was left was to wait for the documents to be delivered.
The car would stay at the store for tinting and interior work, which would take some time. There was no rush, so the two left by taxi.
Back at the café, they found the card luckily. After it was returned, Nancy still seemed a bit out of it. "Brother-in-law, you’re really giving this car to Mom to drive?"
"Yeah, it’s about time she enjoys life a little."
Luis said it like it was the most natural thing in the world.
Nancy still found it hard to believe. "Does Lily know about this?"
"No. Big Sister, you have to keep it a secret, okay?"
"Aren’t... aren’t you afraid she’ll get mad?"
"Why would she be mad?"
Luis looked genuinely puzzled.

The more Nancy thought about it, the weirder it seemed. If it were Daniel who had money to buy her mother-in-law a car, she’d have raised hell at home. What sane man spends that much without discussing it with his wife?
Even if it’s for his mother-in-law, not talking it over with his wife felt... off.
"Lily doesn’t manage your money?"
Nancy couldn’t help asking.
"She doesn’t."
Luis stretched lazily, replying as if it were obvious. "I handle all these investments myself. She doesn’t get it."

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Teacher Blanche Teaching
paragraphs: "Besides, I can’t let her manage it. If she did, forget this car, she wouldn’t even let me buy that bracelet."
"I’m stingy enough, but Lily’s even worse. You know what your sister’s like."

By the time they finished talking, they were already home. Luis stretched again and said, "Big Sister, I’m going to wash up first. Call Mom and Lily. Let’s just grab a quick bite downstairs tonight instead of cooking."
"Okay!"
Even back home, Nancy still felt dazed. But the fact remained: she now had a hundred thousand-dollar Porsche Cayenne under her name. It was surreal.
Right after getting home, Nancy received a call from Teacher Blanche, who chuckled suggestively. "Nancy, that 2,000 dollar kickback from your top-tier man, I’ll let you pass it to him."
"What makes him top-tier?"
"Pays for a hundred thousand-dollar luxury car without blinking, gets himself dirty for a bit of kickback, saves where he should, spends where he should. Isn’t that top-tier?"
"Nancy, you’re not a kid anymore. I know you’ve got high standards, but if a man like this wanted a mistress, I guarantee women would be lining up for him."
Nancy didn’t know how to explain anymore. Suddenly, a thought drifted through her mind: If only this car were mine...
"This money usually comes in cash, by the way. I’ll treat you to dinner after work and hand it over then."
"How can I let you treat me, Teacher? I’ll cover it."
"Alright, see you then. You pick the place."

After hesitating for a moment, Nancy went upstairs and stopped outside the bathroom. Listening to the sound of running water, she softly called out, "Brother-in-law, Teacher Blanche asked me to dinner to hand over that kickback. Do you want to come along?"
"Haha, she is reminding you that it is time to give her a gift to compensate her."
"Then, how much should I give her?"
"Two thousand is enough, but that is your teacher, and you cannot let her look down on you. Big sister, please wait a moment."
Nancy’s phone rang. She picked it up and saw a transfer message for 5,000 dollars.
You know, two thousand dollars might not sound like a lot, but for someone as desperate as her now, it was almost a huge sum of money.
"Why is there so much?"
Nancy accepted it without hesitation but still asked a question.
"Just transfer two thousand to her. The rest will be considered Big Sister’s reward. I cannot let you pay for her dinner yourself."
"As for dinner, I will not go. You two can just catch up on old times."
It would be inconvenient for him to go himself. Anyway, this BUG level skill of knowing everything was like God’s vision. Luis completely trusted the big data information collected by the System.

Nancy also changed her clothes and went out. She first transferred two thousand to Blanche. As expected, Teacher Blanche was very polite and said it was too much. However, after some polite hesitation, she still accepted the money.
The meal was scheduled at the seafood restaurant in the Ocean Hotel. As soon as Blanche sat down, she asked with concern, "How is it? Did you find the card?"
"Found it. Luckily it was not lost. Otherwise, it would be very troublesome to report it lost."
Nancy handed over the menu and said with a smile, "Teacher, take a look at what to eat."
Blanche was not polite at all. She flipped through the menu and said with a smile, "I am happy for you today. I will not be polite. Let us have a good meal to celebrate."
"Salt roasted crab, fish fin soup, and a serving of Momo."
With some roast meat and vegetables added, the price would be over a three hundred dollars, which was considered a normal consumption level here.
As soon as the dishes were served, Teacher Blanche smiled and said, "Very good, Nancy. You are so charming. You really made me jealous today."
"Teacher, please stop teasing me."
Nancy shook her head. It was hard to put into words.
At this time, she was thinking how lucky her sister was. It would be great if this were her husband. Why did he not buy this car for her?

"How dare I? Where did you find such a top notch man? He is so generous. Both of his cards had enough money for the full payment. Honestly, I finally understand why you cannot judge a person by their appearance."
"And let me tell you, if you buy a high end Porsche, you would probably have to pay in full. Otherwise, you would have to take out a mortgage and only have the down payment."
"I have been working here for half a year, and this is the first time I have seen someone pay full price for a Cayenne. They did not even blink an eye. What a rich guy!"
Teacher Blanche blinked and smiled as she enjoyed the food, "I wanted to tell you something today, but now it seems unnecessary."
"What is it?"

"Poke, including many of your classmates, when they find boyfriends, they buy a car and are satisfied with the down payment. But when they have to pay the car loan with their own money, they are all in a mess."

"I originally thought you would only give the down payment, so I wanted to remind you of this. If he does not pay off the car loan, I can find a way to help you get some cash from the car to save you unnecessary burden."
"Now it seems that I overthought it. You have found a truly rich man."

"Poke is relatively okay, but Fianna is even more foolish. She paid a 6,000 dollar down payment for a BMW 3 Series and slept with him for a year. When he kicked her out and she could not pay the loan, she did not even think of a solution. In the end, the car was auctioned off."
"Not a penny left. She was screwed for a year for nothing."

Teacher Blanche sighed earnestly and said, "Do not blame me for being long winded. I have seen a lot of these things. If you are foolish and unworldly, you will easily lose both your money and yourself.
Fangfang was someone Nancy still vaguely remembered. She had posted photos of her BMW on her Whatsapp Add To Day for a while.
Nancy was quite envious at that time because the other person’s car registration was in her own name, while her second hand car had to be registered under two names.
"Nancy, seize the opportunity. Even if you do not want a divorce, that is fine. We cannot let this kind of truly rich person get away."
Teacher Blanche smiled ambiguously and said, "Given his conditions, if your classmates knew about this, it would be like sharks smelling blood."
"He is rich, generous, and willing to spend money on you. Is that not top notch?"
After finishing the meal, she returned home in a daze. In the living room, Luis was lying on the sofa playing with his phone.
Nancy took off her shoes and asked, "Where are Mom and Lily?"
"Walking downstairs. They said there was nothing in the refrigerator, so they went to buy some."
Nancy came to Luis and put down the envelope. Inside the envelope was 2,000 dollars in kickbacks. The finance department always gave cash.
Luis did not even glance at it, still playing with his phone and said, "Just leave it there."
Nancy nodded, hesitated for a moment, and wanted to say something. In the end, she went back to her mother’s room without saying anything, took her clothes, and went to take a shower.

Her mind was in chaos. She did not know whether it was because the house was completely renewed, or because the living room now had air conditioning and she was not used to it, but the constant debt collection calls and messages every day had tortured her to the point of breakdown.
After showering and coming downstairs, the scene she saw made it even harder for her to conceal her jealousy.

Luis casually tossed the envelope containing 2,000 dollars in cash to Lily, who had just returned home. Lily, however, shook her head and refused, "Husband, the 5,000 dollars you gave me last time hasn’t been spent yet. Why are you giving me so much money?"
"You’re pregnant now, you need to focus on nutrition. If you dare to be stingy again, I’ll teach you a lesson."
Knowing that her older sister had come down, and to further provoke her, Luis threw the envelope to his mother in law Ruth.
"Mom, this is for household expenses. You take it."
Ruth blushed and said, "The household allowance you gave last time is still there. You should give your money to Lily."

Calling it household expenses sounded better. Luck was a mysterious thing. Last time, when her son in law gave her money, she had cash in her pocket and felt confident. Recently, she had been on a lucky streak and hadn’t touched a single penny of the 2,000 dollars.
Although two thousand dollars was not a huge amount, the back and forth refusal seemed particularly ironic, because for Nancy now, two thousand was a lot of money.
Just then, Nancy walked over, feeling a pang of sadness, but jokingly said, "There are actually people who refuse money. Your awareness is too high now."
Luis then casually tossed the envelope to Nancy and said with a laugh, "Big Sister, then you keep this money."
"Don’t joke around, it’s not my turn to take it."

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Domestic Violence
paragraphs: "I told you back then buy gold, buy platinum, or even some jade jewelry if nothing else."
"But no, you had to listen to those bullshitting girlfriends of yours and insist on buying a fucking diamond ring..."
The argument between the couple grew increasingly heated, and once money became the focus, it escalated beyond control.
"You owe all that money, and they call me every day, even my parents! How do you explain that?"
"Bullshit! Did you spend any less? Every time I withdrew money, you spent it too. And you used your credit card plenty yourself, didn’t you?"
"My parents help me pay mine back! If you’re so capable, why don’t you get your parents to pay yours?"
"Daniel, you bastard! I must have been blind to ever fall for you!"
"Yeah, yeah, and I fucked you like a bitch too."
"Fuck... Can you even get hard now? If I let you, could you even do it, you worthless piece of shit?"
That line seemed to be the final straw. Daniel’s eyes reddened, and he slapped her hard across the face.
After learning the whole story, Luis stroked his chin, utterly speechless.

Both sides totally deserved it with insults flying like that, it’d be weird if no one threw a punch. But then again, his sister-in-law Nancy was pretty fierce kicking Daniel right in the dick, then running out and calling the cops.
After all, Daniel was a rich kid with a nasty temper, way more spoiled than Nancy. With that kind of attitude, there was no way he’d just take an insult lying down.

Especially when Nancy said he was impotent... any man would fly into a rage. Luis was especially curious about that part, could it be that this brother-in-law had taken a decades-long shortcut straight to impotence right at thirty?
"That bastard Daniel actually dared to hit her? How dare he!"
Arriving at the police station entrance, he ran into Ruth, who was absolutely furious. Judging by her aggressive, blame-shifting energy, she was clearly boiling with anger too.
"Mom, don’t be angry yet. Let’s hear the full story first."
Luis held her back. With her shrewish personality, he was afraid she’d only make things worse once inside.
The door to the mediation room was wide open. As soon as Luis got close, his head started throbbing. Nancy’s roaring voice came from inside:
"My face is swollen! This isn’t a family dispute, it’s domestic violence! I want a medical examination..."
Inside, Nancy sat to one side, still strikingly beautiful, except her face was slightly swollen and red, clearly showing the mark of a slap.

The moment Ruth saw it, she rushed over, cupping her daughter’s lovely face with heartbroken tenderness. Gnashing her teeth, she said, "My baby! Where is that bastard? How dare he do this to my girl? Mom will fight him to the death!"
"Mom!"
Already crying pitifully, Nancy immediately hugged her mother and sobbed with grievance. For a moment, mother and daughter clung to each other, weeping as if someone had died.
A young tigress and an old tigress, even a total outsider could tell these two were not to be messed with.
"Mom, you and big sister stay here for a bit. Let me figure out what’s going on first.
Luis shot a look at the officer handling the case. The cop could also tell this newcomer meant business and promptly followed Luis out of the room.
In the hallway, Luis offered him a cigarette. "How should I address you?"
"Deputy Captain of Public Security, Gasle."
In his early forties, with a square jaw, sharp eyebrows, intense eyes, and a piercing gaze.

Gasle offered a helpless, bitter smile. He was dedicated and capable at his job, having finally worked his way up from the grassroots to the municipal bureau. He thought he was finally done dealing with trivial, ridiculous, melodramatic disputes between uncles and aunties.

But not long after he’d settled in, before he could even enjoy the good life, the bureau launched a "business guidance down to the grassroots" initiative. He got reassigned back to the front lines for a one-year stint. He’d already endured six months of it.
Even though he’d likely make deputy director after this, only those who’d been through it knew just how absurd grassroots drama could be.
Today’s incident was a domestic dispute, a single slap wasn’t enough to qualify as domestic violence, especially since Daniel hadn’t chased after her or used any kind of weapon.
Mediation was the goal, that’s all. Both the captain and deputy captain were out on assignments today, so naturally, as the senior officer, he stepped in.
At first, hearing it was a young couple, Gasle thought it wouldn’t be too hard. At least they’d be more reasonable than older folks, and easier to talk to once they cooled down.
But when he saw them, good lord.
Daniel was clearly a spoiled brat, furious about being dragged into the station.
As for Nancy, stunningly beautiful but making a huge scene, she was hard to please yet hadn’t done anything extreme.
Normally, in this kind of mediation, if it’s between spouses, you talk it out, they make up, and there’s no need to call in family. But these two were tough nuts to crack.
The experienced Gasle immediately separated them and called their families.
"Brother-in-law?"
After Luis introduced himself, Gasle frowned. "Will she listen to you?"
Calling family was risky. One, the relatives might be even more unreasonable and escalate the conflict into a full-on brawl between both sides.
Two, the person who showed up might have no influence, unable to persuade the involved parties or make decisions making it a waste of breath. Luis seemed like the latter.
Probably sensing his hesitation, Luis joked wryly, "Captain Gas, my mother-in-law is famously the biggest shrew in the neighborhood. I doubt you want to deal with her."
Gasle had already picked up on that, which was why he came out as soon as Luis signaled.
The former type was even harder to handle. Though the beautiful mature woman looked incredibly sexy and alluring, the way she’d burst in crying suggested she’d be even more difficult.
"Don’t worry, I still have some say at home," Luis said confidently.
"Your mother-in-law will listen to you?"
Gasle accepted the cigarette but took out his lighter and lit it for Luis.
Now Gasle was smiling warmly, mostly because he liked this young man. They understood each other with just a look, sometimes even colleagues didn’t have that kind of courage.
Luis grinned smugly.
"Yes, and my sister-in-law will, too."
"Oh? You’ve got some skills. How?"
Gasle couldn’t help teasing. "I work for the government, but my mother-in-law still nitpicks everything I do."
"Because I’ve got a few stinkin’ dollars."
Luis chuckled. "Just this month, I bought my mother-in-law thousands of dollars worth of gold jewelry."
Gasle nodded as if everything made sense now and laughed along. The reason was simple, crude, and utterly convincing, way more effective than any high-minded nonsense.

"Could you handle the persuasion here? I’ll go check on the other side. Your eldest brother-in-law’s family has been notified. It seems they have some connections, but it’s a minor issue. Don’t overthink it."
Gasle said lightly, "Hitting someone is still hitting. Family conflicts must be resolved. Don’t be pushy, but it’s also impossible to just let it slide."
"Understood. Thank you for your trouble."
On the surface, Luis appeared simple and honest, even somewhat dull. In reality, having grown up without parental love since childhood, he was practically raised by his grandparents like an orphan.

He entered society early and had already endured all the hardships one could face. Inside, he was sharper than anyone, and his ability to read people and situations was no worse than that of professionals.

Just as he reached the bottom of the stairs, Gasle, feeling relieved from the work pressure, suddenly came to his senses and chuckled wistfully, "Calling me ’sir’ so respectfully, even without flattery, it makes people feel comfortable."
"If someone like him makes you feel at ease, there’s only one possibility: his IQ is higher than yours."
Back in the mediation room, the mother and daughter had mostly stopped crying.
Luis lit a cigarette and pretended to understand the situation. Ruth said furiously, "He must go to jail. I can’t even bring myself to hit my own daughter, how dare he..."
Nancy simply cried without saying a word, her tear-streaked face utterly pitiable and heartbreaking.
Ruth’s loud cursing echoed through the hallway, and even Gasle could hear it from downstairs.
He sighed inwardly, convinced his decision was right, it was better to pin his hopes on this brother-in-law. Dealing with such a stubborn, shrewish woman would cost anyone dearly.
He must be an angel sent by heaven to redeem me, seeing how badly I’ve been tormented by these disrespectful old folks.
After cursing for a while, Ruth was surprised to find that her eldest daughter, who usually shared her temperament the most, remained silent. This was strange, especially since Nancy was the victim.
When she looked again, Luis was sitting to the side, smoking without a word, his face completely expressionless.
Ruth suddenly felt a little guilty. "Um, son-in-law, did I say something wrong?"
Nancy also felt timid because she realized that the brother-in-law she once looked down on was now silently smoking with an expressionless face, exuding an intense and irresistibly masculine aura.
"Mom, don’t be naive."

Luis stubbed out his cigarette and said bluntly, "How could Daniel possibly go to jail? If this is classified as a family conflict, mediation is the priority. If mediation fails, you’ll have to sue yourselves."

sentences.text: "I told you back then buy gold, buy platinum, or even some jade jewelry if nothing else."
"But no, you had to listen to those bullshitting girlfriends of yours and insist on buying a fucking diamond ring..."
The argument between the couple grew increasingly heated, and once money became the focus, it escalated beyond control.
"You owe all that money, and they call me every day, even my parents!
How do you explain that?"
"Bullshit!
Did you spend any less?
Every time I withdrew money, you spent it too.
And you used your credit card plenty yourself, didn’t you?"
"My parents help me pay mine back!
If you’re so capable, why don’t you get your parents to pay yours?"
"Daniel, you bastard!
I must have been blind to ever fall for you!"
"Yeah, yeah, and I fucked you like a bitch too."
"Fuck...
Can you even get hard now?
If I let you, could you even do it, you worthless piece of shit?"
That line seemed to be the final straw.
Daniel’s eyes reddened, and he slapped her hard across the face.
After learning the whole story, Luis stroked his chin, utterly speechless.
Both sides totally deserved it with insults flying like that, it’d be weird if no one threw a punch.
But then again, his sister-in-law Nancy was pretty fierce kicking Daniel right in the dick, then running out and calling the cops.
After all, Daniel was a rich kid with a nasty temper, way more spoiled than Nancy.
With that kind of attitude, there was no way he’d just take an insult lying down.
Especially when Nancy said he was impotent... any man would fly into a rage.
Luis was especially curious about that part, could it be that this brother-in-law had taken a decades-long shortcut straight to impotence right at thirty?
"That bastard Daniel actually dared to hit her?
How dare he!"
Arriving at the police station entrance, he ran into Ruth, who was absolutely furious.
Judging by her aggressive, blame-shifting energy, she was clearly boiling with anger too.
"Mom, don’t be angry yet.
Let’s hear the full story first."
Luis held her back.
With her shrewish personality, he was afraid she’d only make things worse once inside.
The door to the mediation room was wide open.
As soon as Luis got close, his head started throbbing.
Nancy’s roaring voice came from inside:
"My face is swollen!
This isn’t a family dispute, it’s domestic violence!
I want a medical examination..."
Inside, Nancy sat to one side, still strikingly beautiful, except her face was slightly swollen and red, clearly showing the mark of a slap.
The moment Ruth saw it, she rushed over, cupping her daughter’s lovely face with heartbroken tenderness.
Gnashing her teeth, she said, "My baby!
Where is that bastard?
How dare he do this to my girl?
Mom will fight him to the death!"
"Mom!"
Already crying pitifully, Nancy immediately hugged her mother and sobbed with grievance.
For a moment, mother and daughter clung to each other, weeping as if someone had died.
A young tigress and an old tigress, even a total outsider could tell these two were not to be messed with.
"Mom, you and big sister stay here for a bit.
Let me figure out what’s going on first.
Luis shot a look at the officer handling the case.
The cop could also tell this newcomer meant business and promptly followed Luis out of the room.
In the hallway, Luis offered him a cigarette.
"How should I address you?"
"Deputy Captain of Public Security, Gasle."
In his early forties, with a square jaw, sharp eyebrows, intense eyes, and a piercing gaze.
Gasle offered a helpless, bitter smile.
He was dedicated and capable at his job, having finally worked his way up from the grassroots to the municipal bureau.
He thought he was finally done dealing with trivial, ridiculous, melodramatic disputes between uncles and aunties.
But not long after he’d settled in, before he could even enjoy the good life, the bureau launched a "business guidance down to the grassroots" initiative.
He got reassigned back to the front lines for a one-year stint.
He’d already endured six months of it.
Even though he’d likely make deputy director after this, only those who’d been through it knew just how absurd grassroots drama could be.
Today’s incident was a domestic dispute, a single slap wasn’t enough to qualify as domestic violence, especially since Daniel hadn’t chased after her or used any kind of weapon.
Mediation was the goal, that’s all.
Both the captain and deputy captain were out on assignments today, so naturally, as the senior officer, he stepped in.
At first, hearing it was a young couple, Gasle thought it wouldn’t be too hard.
At least they’d be more reasonable than older folks, and easier to talk to once they cooled down.
But when he saw them, good lord.
Daniel was clearly a spoiled brat, furious about being dragged into the station.
As for Nancy, stunningly beautiful but making a huge scene, she was hard to please yet hadn’t done anything extreme.
Normally, in this kind of mediation, if it’s between spouses, you talk it out, they make up, and there’s no need to call in family.
But these two were tough nuts to crack.
The experienced Gasle immediately separated them and called their families.
"Brother-in-law?"
After Luis introduced himself, Gasle frowned.
"Will she listen to you?"
Calling family was risky.
One, the relatives might be even more unreasonable and escalate the conflict into a full-on brawl between both sides.
Two, the person who showed up might have no influence, unable to persuade the involved parties or make decisions making it a waste of breath.
Luis seemed like the latter.
Probably sensing his hesitation, Luis joked wryly, "Captain Gas, my mother-in-law is famously the biggest shrew in the neighborhood.
I doubt you want to deal with her."
Gasle had already picked up on that, which was why he came out as soon as Luis signaled.
The former type was even harder to handle.
Though the beautiful mature woman looked incredibly sexy and alluring, the way she’d burst in crying suggested she’d be even more difficult.
"Don’t worry, I still have some say at home," Luis said confidently.
"Your mother-in-law will listen to you?"
Gasle accepted the cigarette but took out his lighter and lit it for Luis.
Now Gasle was smiling warmly, mostly because he liked this young man.
They understood each other with just a look, sometimes even colleagues didn’t have that kind of courage.
Luis grinned smugly.
"Yes, and my sister-in-law will, too."
"Oh?
You’ve got some skills.
How?"
Gasle couldn’t help teasing.
"I work for the government, but my mother-in-law still nitpicks everything I do."
"Because I’ve got a few stinkin’ dollars."

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Hela To Medidate
paragraphs: "But he already hit..." Ruth protested unwillingly.
"So what? There was no extreme behavior, no serious consequences. It’s the same outcome."
Luis said dismissively, "My eldest brother-in-law may not be much, but his parents have connections. Even if you try to escalate this, it’s impossible."
"What? Is he still trying to use his connections to frame us?" Ruth slammed the table and stood up. Luis didn’t say a word, just looked at her expressionlessly.
In the past, such behavior would have earned him at least a slap, but now Ruth was stunned, then hesitated with a guilty conscience.
Nancy even tugged at her mother’s sleeve and said, "Mom, don’t take your anger out on Brother-in-law. That’s not good."
With this, Ruth found an excuse to sit back down, though still unwilling. "Son-in-law, what do you think we should do? You’re the head of our household now. Give us your word."
"No matter how much you escalate this, it won’t become a big deal."
"Even if you involve my father-in-law, who has some connections, it’s still the same. This is just a trivial matter."
Hearing this, both mother and daughter hesitated. Involving Arthur was out of the question, their relationship was already in name only. Even if he showed up, he’d likely do the bare minimum.
After this, the mother and daughter looked at Luis with even more tenderness and eagerness, because they knew he wasn’t a cold or indifferent person.

Despite suffering so much humiliation as a live-in son-in-law, he was actually financially independent. Yet, he remained gentle and attentive to his wife, fully embracing his role and doting on her in every way.
No sweet talk, no empty promises just genuine affection reflected in the details of everyday life.
Both mother and daughter had a strange thought: What did Lily do to deserve this? Even as a mother who should be happy for her daughter, Ruth couldn’t shake this nagging feeling.
In their eyes, Lily was still the ugly girl before her systematic transformation, while the son-in-law was gentle, considerate, handsome, well-built, and now wealthy.
Despite the inappropriate tensions, the son-in-law behaved impeccably at home, treating his mother-in-law and everyone else with utmost respect. There was simply no fault to find with him.
Nancy grew angry at the comparison, while Ruth felt particularly guilty. Even though nothing physical had happened between her and the son-in-law, she suddenly felt her daughter was unworthy of him.
Just as Luis was thinking about how to quickly resolve this nonsense, the System’s voice rang in his mind:
"Ding... System Quest: The Tall and Sexy Sister-in-Law side quest triggered. Easter egg unlocked. Use blind box to obtain exclusive skill."
"Sister-in-Law Side Quest (Fuck Your Mother), generating (extremely fast)."
Luis was completely baffled. What the hell kind of mission was this? The sister-in-law’s derivative mission was just the mother-in-law.
But right now, Luis truly had no time to ponder this, because Ruth grabbed his hand and demanded, "Son-in-law, in this matter, are we really just going to have to accept that we’re at a loss??"
Nancy’s resentment had clearly diminished quite a bit, but Ruth’s shrewish nature was evident, if she didn’t come out on top, she considered it a loss. She was truly trouble.
This was the immediate issue that needed handling. Luis thought for a moment and asked, "Sister, you’ve been here a while, do you know the name of that police officer?
"No, I don’t!"
"His name is Gasle. I know him. If you don’t believe me, you can go down and see for yourself later."
Luis said casually, "Mom, do you want to handle how this gets resolved, or should I take care of it?"
There was almost a tone of pressure in his words, if you, as the elder, want to handle it, then I’ll step back. But if you trust me to deal with it, then don’t you dare spout nonsense.
This was already stern enough, but it had no effect on a shrew. Knowing exactly what kind of person his mother-in-law was, Luis’s words weren’t much of a reassurance.
"Son-in-law, then what should we do?"
"Let it cool..."
Luis said bluntly, "In matters like this, between husband and wife, it’s all about smoothing things over. There’s no injury assessment by criminal standards, so it’s hard to say anything definitive."
"Daniel’s family definitely has connections. I called in some favors too, but this matter is too minor to cause any real stir."
The moment Ruth heard this, she exploded. "So what? My eldest daughter was just bullied for nothing?"
Normally, in this situation, Nancy would have erupted too. Mother and daughter would play off each other, a veritable shrew-PLUS level force.
Luis simply continued smoking, adding lightly, "Mom, if you’re handling this, I’ll take my leave then, alright?"

Dealing with this type of shrew required no reasoning, no attempts at being understanding or polite. The more submissive you were, the less say you had. Honestly, Ruth was indeed fierce, but she still had a good sense of perception.
Seeing Luis getting a little angry, Ruth backed down. "I just feel it’s unfair for your elder sister."
Luis instinctively glanced at Nancy. Somehow, his sister-in-law still lacked the presence his mother-in-law had. His mother-in-law was already known for her ferocity at Nancy’s age.
If this had happened to Ruth, and Daniel had dared to lay a hand on her, at the very least his face would have been clawed to shreds, not like Nancy, who ran away first and then called the police.
"Mom, matters between husband and wife aren’t easy to judge. Don’t waste energy thinking about putting Daniel behind bars, it’s not happening."

Ruth was no longer assertive in front of her second son-in-law. Nancy thought it over and said softly, "Mom, I don’t think it’s realistic either. Let’s just let brother-in-law decide. After all, making a scene here isn’t a good look."
Luis added, "Mom, you head back first. I’ll handle this."
"Fine. I’ll go complain to your mother-in-law later, what right does she have..."
Though still fuming, Ruth actually listened and left first. As she went, she glanced around sneakily, as if trying to spot where Daniel was so she could curse him out thoroughly.
Gasle came over as well, smiling. "Your mother-in-law is here too. Let’s talk first."
It suddenly dawned on Luis, the side mission unlocked through the sister-in-law quest... could it be referring to Daniel’s mother? Damn, that was almost too thoughtful.
Knowing that Ruth had left cursing and grumbling, Gasle found himself looking at Luis with even more approval. Damn, if only he had someone this sharp under his command.
Both sides had sent middle-aged women. When Gasle heard Daniel’s mother was coming too, cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
This kind of situation was practically classic at the police station. Mothers were usually protective of their kids, no matter who was right or wrong, they’d show up furious.
Especially since Ruth clearly wasn’t the reasonable type, and upon hearing Daniel was an only son well, that meant his mother probably wasn’t someone to mess with either.
This wasn’t just Mars hitting Earth, it was worse. Thankfully, Luis had sent Ruth away beforehand. If the two had met, who knows how things would’ve escalated.

The door opened. A well-fitted dress accentuated her figure and air of elegance. Her wavy long hair was tied up simply and neatly. She carried a designer bag, everything about her screamed upper class.

Her features were sharp, her eyes large and lively. Light makeup enhanced her refined appearance. She might not be stunningly gorgeous, but she was undoubtedly a captivating beauty with enduring charm.
Time hadn’t left her weathered; instead, it had bestowed a mature, alluring elegance.
Daniel’s mother, Hela, was also a great beauty. Standing next to Nancy, she not only held her own but exuded even more mature femininity.

Truth be told, that bastard Daniel might be a piece of work, but he did have that slick, pretty-boy look clearly inherited from his mother. But Hela knew how to present herself better, always leaving a striking impression.
Ruth had charm and beauty too, but she wasn’t as skilled at styling. Combined with that elite, sophisticated aura, Hela was absolutely a top-tier stunner who could make anyone’s pulse race.
"Mom!"
Nancy stood up immediately.
Hela had a powerful presence. She walked in, sat down gracefully, and greeted with a smile, "My brother-in-law is here too. I heard my mother-in-law was here earlier."
"I asked her to head back first!"
Luis said offhandedly, "It’s not a big deal between the young couple. It’s not good for parents to get too involved when emotions are high."
"How sensible. I feel the same way!"

Hela was slightly taken aback, then smiled gracefully and stroked Nancy’s cheek. "That idiot, how could he raise a hand against his own gorgeous wife? He really needs to be taught a lesson. If his father weren’t out of town, he’d be getting a beating right now."
As an only child, Daniel was thoroughly spoiled by Hela, a classic case of "a loving mother spoils the son."
But regardless, her verbal stance was clear. Then Hela asked another question: "I’ve been getting calls lately saying you owe money. What’s going on?"
The question made Nancy nervous. She immediately said, "It’s scam calls. Ignore them."
"But the harassment is getting out of hand."
Hela thought for a moment and said, "In this matter, Daniel was wrong. No matter what, he shouldn’t have resorted to violence. I apologize on his behalf."
"We’re all family. There’s no need to make a scene here. Why don’t you stay at your parents’ place for a few days to cool off?"
