paragraphs: "I’ll have Daniel apologize to you later. All couples argue, if you come to the police station every time you quarrel, will you be heading to court next?"
Though Hela maintained a smile throughout, her tone was particularly assertive, less a discussion, more a decision already made.
Nancy was not originally lacking in presence compared to her, but now, buried under a pile of debts, she clearly lost her confidence.
After hesitating for a moment, she suddenly looked at Luis. Luis immediately smiled and said, "Okay, but since everyone is still angry right now, it’s better to avoid meeting."
"The second son-in-law is considerate enough. Then, auntie will take your brother-in-law away first."
Hela stood up, smiling warmly, and said, "Later, I will have Daniel apologize to you."

After signing the mediation agreement, they could see from upstairs that Daniel followed Hela into her BMW 5 Series. From his cursing and grumbling, it seemed he was complaining that Nancy had made a big deal out of nothing.
"Didn’t you drive here?"
Standing at the entrance of the police station, Nancy asked subconsciously.
"Taking a taxi is much more convenient than driving."
Nancy’s mood was clearly quite low. After returning home, she told Ruth the outcome. Ruth was furious but also somewhat helpless.
After all, the fact that Hela belonged to the elite class was undeniable. Although she treated people politely, deep down, she looked down on the Wood family.

In terms of family background, both she and her husband held leadership positions. At the very least, their family was intact and moderately wealthy. In contrast, Arthur from the Wood family worked in construction engineering, which in her eyes made him nothing more than a country bumpkin.
As for Ruth, she was a shrew, a mere housewife. No matter how little interaction they had, it was obvious she lacked refinement.

Moreover, it was no secret that Arthur kept a mistress outside. In Hela’s view, the Wood family had a very disordered upbringing. The only thing they could boast about was Nancy’s looks, marrying a beautiful daughter-in-law was acceptable.
Even among the flight attendants, Nancy, who had been called the campus belle, stood out from the crowd. At 172 cm tall, wearing high heels made Daniel look short.

As for her appearance, it went without saying. Being the campus belle in a school where women outnumbered men meant she was absolutely stunning. With a face like that, she could easily make a name for herself even in an art school or film academy.
She chose to become a flight attendant mainly because her academic performance was poor, and she didn’t enter the entertainment industry because her family lacked the money to invest.
Even under these circumstances, Hela still looked down on her daughter-in-law, believing Nancy was nothing but a pretty vase and that her son had been foolishly blinded by lust.

For someone like Daniel, who idlely relied on his parents without ambition, to actually think Nancy wasn’t good enough for his precious son, Hela was nothing but a doting mother who had spoiled her child.
"Elder Sister, don’t move!"
Luis brought ice cubes wrapped in a towel and gently pressed it against the dazed Nancy’s face, saying, "Although it’s not serious, it’s better to ice it. The swelling will go down soon."
"Thank you, I can do it myself!"
Nancy took the ice, feeling that this was somewhat inappropriate.
Luis didn’t mind. He sat to the side, smoking and fiddling with his phone.

Ruth didn’t see anything wrong with this behavior. Instead, she smiled with warmth and approval, "Look how thoughtful your brother-in-law is. Sometimes, Mom feels even we women aren’t as attentive as him."
"Yeah, that girl Lily, if she dares to play the pitiful little wife in front of me again, I’ll definitely give her a hard slap.
Nancy’s mood gradually brightened. She glanced subconsciously at her brother-in-law, then thought of her own husband, and felt a twist of jealousy in her heart.
"Wife, I didn’t buy groceries for dinner. Let’s eat out."
"Can’t you be more conscious as a pregnant woman? Please don’t pinch pennies when it comes to food."
"Last time, didn’t you say your colleague mentioned that new teppanyaki place..."
"It’s settled then. I’ll pick you up after work."
Luis hung up the phone and said, "Mom, I’ll send you the location. You and Elder Sister go first. I’ll pick up Lily after work."
Ruth said coquettishly, "Eating out again? What a waste of money."
"Some things are worth spending on. Lily’s colleagues have been tempting her with talk of it, of course I have to take her today."
"See you later."

Lily and Yana worked at a community hospital. The small hospital mainly handled physical exams and issued health certificates. It was quite laid-back, but the pay wasn’t high, jokingly referred to as a place suited for retirement.
"Husband, why are you here so early?"
The hospital was very quiet, with only a few people getting IV drips in the outpatient hall. Lily was sitting at the payment counter and stood up in delight when she saw her husband.
"It’s so hot outside. Is the air conditioning here working alright?"
Luis smiled and handed her the juice he’d bought on the way, of course, he’d bought multiple cups, not just one. Lily immediately shared them with her supervisor and close colleagues.
"Honey, there’s still half an hour until get off work."
The payment counter wasn’t a place anyone could just enter. The other colleagues tactfully let Lily step out to spend time with her husband.
"Wife, last time you mentioned hair removal, I want to try it."
Luis lowered his voice and said with a mischievous grin, "The hair’s gotten a bit long, it’s inconvenient. You always say it’s prickly and uncomfortable. Since it’s a good time, why not help me out?"
"How could I do it for you? I’ve long forgotten how!"
Lily’s face flushed. It was true she had trained in nursing.

But after finishing her internship and obtaining her license, she never pursued further certifications. Over the years, she’d been doing easy clerical work, and whatever knowledge she’d had was long returned to her teachers.
"Then what should I do? Can you find a colleague who knows how?"
Lily thought for a moment, then said softly, "How about we ask Aunt Yana? Even though she’s now the head nurse, she has plenty of experience.
"Ask her? Wouldn’t that be awkward?"
Luis’s eyes lit up, though on the surface he feigned embarrassment and shyness.
"I wouldn’t trust anyone else. What if they accidentally nicked your dick? That would be dangerous."

While speaking, Lily texted to ask, then suddenly stuck out her tongue and said, "I forgot she wasn’t working today, she took the capital. Aunt Yana said for you to come find her next time. She’ll take care of it in just a few strokes."
"How can she talk about such an important part of me like she’s slicing pork?"
"Hehe, I’m the one who loves that important part of yours the most. Aunt Yana is an elder and a seasoned nurse, you think she’d even glance twice at you?"
Not only did she glance, she even rode it... To be honest, your mom’s best friend was really something when she was on top.
The teppanyaki restaurant that Lily had been longing for was a high-end establishment serving Japanese cuisine that felt more like Western food.

The average spending per person was quite high. Signature dishes included grilled baby lobster, Pacific crab, sole fish, teppanyaki steak, and roasted lamb chops. Ordering them one by one brought the bill to over 500 dollars.
"What a rip-off!"
"I’m so full, Mom. Let’s go for a walk."
After dinner, the young couple strolled hand in hand, openly flaunting their affection.

After returning home, Ruth unusually did not go out to play cards. After washing up, the two sisters and their mother-in-law gathered in the living room to binge-watch TV dramas. Luis did not particularly enjoy those soap operas.
He simply retreated to his room, opened the system interface, and decided to try his luck by drawing more blind boxes.
As soon as he entered, the system issued a prompt tone:

"Ding... This is a derivative dungeon of the Tall and Sexy Sister-in-Law mission (fuck your mother). The progression difficulty is high. It is recommended that the host exchange two blind boxes for a skill exclusive to this dungeon."
"There’s such a thing?"
Luis pondered why the difficulty was so high. It was because of Hela’s status. She was arrogant and looked down on others. Conquering her through normal strategies would be challenging.
Might as well keep it simple and since the goal was to fuck her, there was no need for fancy tricks.

But two blind boxes? Luis hesitated for a moment. Although Hela was also a mature and beautiful woman, and absolutely stunning when dressed up, her appeal to Luis wasn’t that strong. Her condescending attitude instinctively disgusted him. The biggest attraction was truly because she was Daniel’s mother.
After fucking her, he could curse, "Fuck your mother!" and he wouldn’t be lying at all.
"Host, would you like to redeem it? The system indicates that this quest item is absolutely perfect for use."
Luis’s mind was in turmoil as he asked, "What’s the mission reward?"
"Ding... Tall and Sexy Sister-in-Law quest derivative dungeon (fuck your mother), creampie Hela, quest reward: one random blind box and one attribute point."
This reward seemed a bit meager, especially at the cost of two blind boxes??
Luis was truly torn between conscience and desire. The main reason was that Luis didn’t want to spend time and energy on Hela, let alone engage in any romantic entanglements.

Nancy’s delicate brows furrowed slightly. After this time together, Luis could pretty much confirm one thing:

This was an extremely private matter for her. Now, she knew she couldn’t hide it any longer.

"New cars always use temporary license plates first, the kind that are just a piece of paper.
Only used cars that are transferred with their existing plates get the proper metal license plates right away.
At this point, Teacher Blanche added in the group: "I’m not lying to you all.
Nancy really did buy a Cayenne."
"Where did she get that much money?"
"A man bought it for her.
The card I saw was under a man’s name, and the signature was a man’s, but the car is registered under Nancy’s name."
"So even the campus belle Nancy has fallen from grace, huh?
But I haven’t heard anything about her getting a divorce.
How did she manage to find some old man to keep her???"
"He’s not an old man, he’s a pretty casual and handsome young guy.
He looks even younger than Nancy."
"Teacher, you must be joking.
The campus belle Nancy is robbing the cradle, and he paid in full for her to get a Cayenne?"
The class group chat exploded with activity.
Some classmates started privately messaging Nancy to ask questions or offer congratulations.
Many speculated whether Nancy had won the lottery and had been testing who her true friends were by asking to borrow money.
It seemed like those internet memes about testing relationships through borrowing money might actually be real.
Nancy wanted to explain, but her vanity got the better of her.
She replied: "He’s pursuing me.
I’m still considering whether to accept or not."
This made the group even more frenzied.
These night owls, awake in the dead of night, were suddenly wide awake, their jealousy probably reaching unprecedented levels:
"Nancy, you’ve got to be kidding.
He paid in full for your car and he’s still just pursuing you?
What kind of foolish son of a wealthy family is he?"
Clearly, no one in the group believed such nonsense.
In this materialistic society, reality was too harsh, even if you slept with someone until you were worn out, you might not get any real tangible benefits.
"If he’s still pursuing you and already bought you a Cayenne, what kind of bullshit is that?
This is pure nonsense.
Even a green tea bitch who reads too much young adult fiction wouldn’t fall for that."
After sending the message, Nancy herself felt how hypocritical it sounded, but it was too late to take it back.
At that moment, Teacher Blanche said in the group: "Alright, you little gossips, why are you digging so much?"
"Campus belle Nancy, you’re something else, already married and still pulling this off?
Where did you find this young boy-toy?
If you don’t want him, introduce him to me."
"You’re not picky at all, are you..."
"If campus belle Nancy dumps him, I’ll be heartbroken.
In that case, I’ll take care of him and comfort him myself."
"Wow, you’re trying to steal both the man and the money... that’s downright insane.
Count me in, let’s form a team."
The group chattered away excitedly, their words tinged with unmistakable envy and jealousy toward Nancy for managing to land a wealthy young man even after marriage.
Being part of this group, Nancy actually relished the feeling of being envied and admired.
For a moment, she felt quite pleased.
But then she saw the message from Anglo, clearly informing her that the court had accepted the case.
Pre-trial mediation would begin next week, and if mediation failed, they would have no choice but to go to court.
"Don’t say I didn’t warn you, get yourself a good lawyer.
We’ll see each other in court."
Nancy let out a sigh.
As she placed a hand on her chest, she felt a slight pain.
She walked to the mirror and took off her bra.
Her round, snow-white C-cup breasts were exceptionally beautiful, perfectly full and firm, so much so that they could be called works of art.
Yet, on the milky-white skin of her breasts, there were faint bruises.
Touching it made her wince with pain, and Nancy’s face flushed as she recalled the absurd events of the night.
At first, she hadn’t believed that Nova Media would go so far, it was practically like forcing decent women into prostitution.
Later, as if bewitched, she had agreed to her brother-in-law’s teasing, joking suggestion to go "whoring" together.
What really got to her was seeing Maria, she just couldn’t stay calm.
Jealousy and resentment burned in her heart.
She wanted to see how this unearthly, angelic woman would act when she was reduced to a whore.
It was like being possessed by inner demons and desire, she couldn’t control herself.
She had wildly encouraged her brother-in-law to cheat while her sister was pregnant.
Now, looking back, it all felt so insane, like a dream.

Right before her eyes, barely a meter away, her brother-in-law was ruthlessly fucking her aunt-in-law, that dignified, elegant elder, who was moaning with satisfaction like a bitch in heat, arching her hips high to meet his thrusts.
And the craziest part was herself: her whole body grew feverish, her panties soaked through.

Was it because the pressure had been too much lately?
Ever since she got married, she had felt stifled.
Was that why these perverted thoughts emerged?
She couldn’t make sense of it...
Compared to her inner chaos, Luis was far more at ease.
Before he fell asleep, a system notification echoed in his mind:

Reward is being generated."
The original task was to fuck Daniel’s mother, Hela.
By accident, he had fucked her sister Maria first.
Damn, it was like heading toward a threesome with both sisters.

No doubt about it, the System sure knew how to have fun.
Luis was overjoyed; he almost felt like grabbing Nancy’s hand and thanking her properly.
The morning was wonderful for Lily.
Men like morning blowjobs, but women couldn’t escape the same appeal either.
Feeling slightly guilty, Luis turned off the alarm early and started the new day by giving his wife a beautiful climax through morning oral.
After seeing his wife off to work, Luis drove to the suburbs.
He used to work at a private auto repair shop beside the highway.
The boss, Fatty, was Luis’s master.
Back then, Fatty was still doing contracted work for others and hadn’t started his own business.
Now, he was a small boss.

chapters.title: Chapter 129: Rococo
paragraphs: "Not bad, you really did get handsomer," Fatty said with a lewd grin. "Leem told me you managed to nail that toughest housewife of his, the one from a good family. Impressive, impressive."
"Master, you guys talk about this stuff too?" Luis’s eyes widened.
"What’s the big deal? Leem’s also a client here. We make money off each other. We’ve had drinks a few times, every time, he hooks me up with some crazy good-value girls."
Fatty chuckled. "Leem said the one you had yesterday was super difficult and dramatic. No service, complaining about this and that, refusing to do anything. She pissed him off so bad."
"Then he sent her your photo, and she finally agreed to come out."
"Damn, kid. You’re looking pretty fine now. Got a bit of my style back in the day."
As they chatted, Luis test-drove the car. When it came time to pay, he smiled and said, "You’re living the good life, Master. I bet your wife’s not too busy these days either, huh?"
"She’s swamped. Why, you got some trouble?" Fatty asked with concern.

His feelings toward Luis were genuine. Back in the day, when Fatty had just finished his apprenticeship and started doing panel-beating jobs on contract, the money was slim and the work was exhausting. Luis was his only apprentice.
Luis worked under him for two years, diligent, responsible, and really thoughtful. Their relationship had long become like family.

When Fatty was thinner, he was actually quite good-looking. Despite his humble background, he managed to win over the only daughter of a city family, a wife who even had a master’s degree. Seriously impressive.

When his career started taking off, his wife’s family bought this plot of land, built the auto repair shop, and supported him. He had them all wrapped around his finger, truly a master at playing the tough freeloader.
"It’s a relative having some issues. Wanted to ask your wife for advice."

Fatty and his wife had one daughter. After giving birth, his wife went back to school and took exams. Once the kid started school, she returned to work. Now she had her own office at the city’s biggest law firm, fully part of the elite class.
"Well... my wife’s pretty pissed off right now. If I bring it up, she’ll probably tear me a new one."
Fatty scratched his head awkwardly. "You’ve got her number, right? Just hit her up yourself."
Luis couldn’t resist teasing him. "Whoa, Master, feeling brave? Daring to argue with the wife now?"
"Ah, it’s not like that. Hard to explain quickly. Anyway, you’ve got her number. Reach out yourself."
Luis’s master might look tough and rough, a real man’s man, generous and upright, but in private, he was totally henpecked.
First, because his wife’s family had helped him tremendously, no denying that. Second, this pretty wife of his was no trophy.
A top-tier law school graduate, her father was an official, her mother a retired judge, high-caliber talent with serious presence.
A woman with strong opinions, truly admirable, a real independent woman of the new era.
Driving out in his well-maintained second-hand Nissan, Luis thought for a bit and decided to call his master’s wife first. When she answered, her voice was just as he remembered, elegant and warm:
"Luis, what brings this call all of a sudden?"
The nickname had a teasing tone. As Fatty’s only apprentice, Luis had a pretty good relationship with his master’s wife.
Fatty only had one daughter, and his wife had once joked that with Luis as their apprentice, they finally had one of each, a son and a daughter.
"You busy, Master’s Wife?
"You little rascal. You showed up once when my office opened, dropped off a red envelope, and then vanished."
"Master’s Wife, I heard from Master you’ve been super busy. Didn’t want to interrupt your work."
"And what makes you brave enough now? You never call without a reason."
"There’s something I wanted to ask your advice about."
"My consultation fees are pretty steep these days. When did you become such a big spender?"

She giggled, then her tone turned playful. "You punk, I’ve got a ton of cases to review today. I’ll call you tomorrow. It’s been ages, you still haven’t learned to show your master’s wife some respect, have you?"
"How about I treat you to dinner tomorrow? Your favorite food."
"Deal."
Hanging up, Luis saw it was already 10:30. After a moment’s thought, he sent a message to his wife, Lily, then drove straight to the Ocean Hotel.

The community hospital was always a quiet place, with only outpatient services and no emergency department. During the daytime, it mostly handled minor illnesses like colds and flu, along with some routine health check-ups.
Medical disputes were practically nonexistent, making it an ideal environment for retirees or expectant mothers.

The billing department didn’t require night shifts, any emergency cases sent here would be tantamount to seeking death, so Lily’s job was relaxed, and Luis wasn’t worried about her overexerting herself.
"Hello, brother-in-law! Hello, brother-in-law!"
It was so tranquil here that employees could even take midday breaks. In the cafeteria, Lily was chatting with several younger female coworkers, two who reported to her and a few friendly nurses.
"Honey, what did you bring?"
Lily smiled charmingly, her face glowing with happiness.

Luis had called earlier, telling her not to buy a boxed lunch and to wait for him to bring food instead. When her close girlfriends heard, they playfully demanded to share the "love meal," and after confirming the headcount, Luis readily agreed.
Lily’s favorability meter was currently at 96% and hadn’t budged for a while. Luis wanted to pamper her a bit to raise it.

Although the System didn’t explicitly state the purpose of the favorability meter, it seemed to serve mainly as a reference to gauge what actions were appropriate toward the other person, Luis was no stranger to web novels. He knew there had to be hidden functions or potential easter eggs and rewards tied to it, so he took great care to maintain her favorability and prevent it from dropping.
Luis opened the trunk, and the girls swarmed over, carrying the food into the cafeteria.
"Wow, long live brother-in-law!"
"Sister Lily is so lucky! I thought brother-in-law made the lunch himself, but this is a full-on feast!"
"Long live Boss Lily! Brother-in-law is so thoughtful!"
No woman is immune to vanity. The moment the containers were opened, the girls squealed with delight, drawing curious onlookers from nearby.
"With so many people, individual boxed meals would’ve been inconvenient, and I wasn’t sure about everyone’s preferences, so I picked up some of my wife’s favorites on the way."
The first package was impressive right away, the Ocean Hotel was famous for its seafood feasts, and just the packaging alone built anticipation.
Fried crab, butter-fried shrimp, garlic mantis shrimp, a classic roasted meat platter, and most extravagantly, a portion of abalone and soup for each person...
The second package contained Fiery cuisine: Lily’s favorite sliced pork in spicy broth, mapo tofu, extra-spicy chicken perfect with rice, and finally, a strawberry smoothie for everyone.
"Brother-in-law, you picked up all these delicious things on the way?"
"And they’re all Sister Lily’s favorites! Today we’re benefiting from her good fortune~"
The girl speaking had an especially sweet voice, and on closer look, she was quite pretty, her eyes curved like crescent moons, sparkling with lively charm.
A delicate, upturned nose, a lovely cherry-like mouth, and a perfectly shaped oval face made her a striking beauty.

This little beauty had just graduated from nursing school and was interning here. When she arrived, she immediately caught everyone’s attention, turns out she was the school belle of her year. For her to earn that title at a nursing school said a lot about her looks.
Rumor had it, from what Lily mentioned, that she had countless suitors and was quite the proud little peacock. Currently single, her favorite hobby was cosplay.
Her name was Rococo. What stuck most in Luis’s memory was Lily mentioning they’d gone to a spa together once, Rococo’s skin was so fair it practically glowed.
"Keke, this one’s for you, your sister mentioned you’d like it."
Luis took out a separate box: extra-spicy popcorn shrimp.
"Wow, brother-in-law, I only said that offhand! You remembered?"
"If I didn’t, your sister would’ve smashed my head in."
After some laughter, Luis, who’d only brought six meals, set the food down and said cheerfully, "Enjoy, everyone!"
"Hubby, aren’t you eating with us?" Lily asked with concern.
Luis shook his head. "No, I need to stop by the bookstore. That book I mentioned last time came in, gotta pick it up."
"Make sure you rest, sweetheart!"
Luis drove off in his newly bought car. Other staff in the cafeteria came over to sneak a bite, some envious, some admiring, but Lily smiled blissfully throughout.
One commented with a hint of jealousy, "Such surface-level concern, Lily. You’re pregnant and still riding an e-bike to work. Why doesn’t he let you drive the car?"
Lily shook her head. "I haven’t gotten my license yet. I wouldn’t dare drive even if he gave it to me."
Rococo giggled. "Sister Lily, I heard you’ve been working on that license for a year."
Another voice chimed in, tinged with envy, "Aunt Yana said Lily’s husband is loaded. Why’d he buy a Nissan? A new one’s only like, what, over 10,000 dollars? This one’s probably used."
"My husband said it’s for practice."
Though gentle by nature, Lily was still a woman. In this setting, her inner "green tea" instincts effortlessly kicked in, letting her show off a little.

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Thought Of Buying A Place
paragraphs: She put on a slightly embarrassed expression. "He said we should start with a cheap one, no big deal if it gets scratched or bumped. Once we’re used to driving, we’ll upgrade."
A nosy busybody pressed further, "Upgrade to what, then?"
"I’m not sure, I don’t know much about cars. But I feel like we shouldn’t get anything too expensive."
That meal firmly placed Lily in the spotlight. Everyone had heard of partners delivering food, but no one expected it to be this extravagant.
"You’re an old married couple already, yet you’re still this loving..."
Rococo’s remark made the other women even greener with envy. Such attentiveness was expected during the pursuit phase or early dating, even acting like a "simp" was forgivable then.

But everyone knew Lily and Luis had been high school sweethearts who’d gone the distance and married. Normally, old couples found even casual touch annoying and bickered at the slightest disagreement.
Even during pregnancy, few couples remained this affectionate. Some time back, the thickness of that Summer Cicada series bracelet on Lily’s wrist had made countless people burn with envy.
After all, in everyone’s eyes, Lily was ordinarily average, even downright plain, some even called her ugly.
But now, Luis stood at 185 cm with a model-like figure. Though he dressed casually, he carried a handsome aura. They were a complete mismatch.
"Lily, have you mentioned your dorm application to your brother-in-law yet?"
Rococo took a sip of her strawberry juice and asked the question almost instinctively.
"No, I haven’t!"
Lily shook her head gently and said, "I’m not that delicate. Taking naps at the office is practically the same anyway. It’s not like the dormitory is free."
"It’s only two hundred dollars a month, and you still want to save that?"
Rococo’s eyes widened in disbelief. She gritted her teeth and said, "It can’t be that my brother-in-law is being stingy, can it? He doesn’t strike me as that kind of person."

The community hospital had a dormitory building—a simple three-story structure, but less than half of it was occupied. Aside from staff who had moved from out of town, most of the medical workers here were locals who saw no need to spend the money.
The dorm rooms were basic: just over 20 square meters with a toilet, and no option for cooking, which made them highly inconvenient. Anyone with a family would never choose to live there.
Moreover, the dormitories were barebones, completely unfurnished, and not open to the public. As a result, less than half of the rooms were ever occupied.
"It’s not that—I have the money myself," Lily explained immediately. "But I can’t tell him. You know how he is—if I even mention it, he’ll go all out and turn it into some huge project."

Rococo caught the faint tone of complaint in Lily’s voice—how her husband spent freely on new furniture and clothes without a second thought. So it wasn’t that her brother-in-law was stingy; it was her sister who was being frugal.

"Listen, Lily—what was before is before. Now is different. You’re pregnant now; you need proper rest during your lunch break. We have two whole hours. You can’t just lie over your desk—what if it hurts the baby?"
Lily looked taken aback by Rococo’s words.
Seizing the moment, Rococo snatched up Lily’s phone, scrolled through her chat history, and copied Luis’s number.
Lily didn’t try to take it back. She was too trusting and didn’t overthink it. She just asked, "What are you doing?"
"If you won’t tell him, I will!"
Rococo said playfully, "If my dear sister is too shy to whisper in his ear, then I’ll be the divine helper! I can’t stand to see you uncomfortable."
Lily hesitated. "But it’s only for a short nap at noon. It feels like such a waste."
"It’s fine, Lily—I’ll pitch in 200 for utilities. Let’s share the room!"
Rococo put on a pitiful look and said, "Renting outside is way too expensive. My landlord is a total creep—always bothering me, and my underwear keeps going missing."

As an intern, Rococo wasn’t eligible to apply for a dorm room unless she used someone else’s name. It was a frustrating situation. If sharing a room meant she could even sleep on the floor, she’d take it.
"Sis, I’ll pay you back that thousand I borrowed as soon as I get my paycheck," Rococo added softly, returning the phone with a hint of shame.

She might have seemed outgoing and cheerful, into cosplay and all, but Lily—ever the caring big sister—knew she had it rough. What looked like an expensive hobby was actually Rococo using her looks to pick up side gigs as a promotional model.
As for her family situation, Rococo never talked about it. Lily was thoughtful enough not to pry. Clearly, things weren’t easy for her.
"Please, Sis—you only need the room at noon. That means I’ll have a place to stay at night. I’m begging you."
Lily thought it over. "Alright, I’ll put in an application. But when you talk to your brother-in-law, be careful how you phrase it, okay? I don’t want him to worry too much."
"Got it! Long live Sister Lily!"

Yana hadn’t returned yet, but Ruth had already gathered her full set of card partners. All four were sipping tea, waiting to start playing right after lunch.

Aunt Kiara looked impatient. Seeing others already eating, she snapped, "Ruth, is your son-in-law messing with us? He said he’d bring us lunch—so where is he?"
"If he’s bringing it just for you, that’s one thing, but for all of us? What’s going on? You’re not pulling our leg, are you?"
Ruth, looking especially glamorous today, snorted. "My son-in-law said it’s all about relationship spending—the money has to be used while it’s timely. You wouldn’t get it."

"You’re always going on about how your son-in-law is financially free, but I’ve never seen him in luxury cars or name brands," Aunt Kiara went on. "Ruth, don’t tell me he won some lottery and is now just pretending to be rich."
"Get lost! My son-in-law is incredibly frugal with himself, but you have no idea how generous he is to our family."

"Oho, sounds almost convincing," Aunt Kiara said with a sneer. "Well, in that case—since you’re remodeling into a duplex, old man’s place upstairs is going up for sale. Perfect timing, since your daughter is pregnant—you’ll need more space, right?"
The resettlement housing at Central Garden had three units per floor. The one she mentioned was right next to the upstairs duplex.

Aunt Kiara ran a real estate agency. Old man Chen’s apartment had been listed for a long time without any buyers. Over 50 square meters, beautifully renovated originally for his son’s wedding, but his son refused to come back, staying in a first-tier city instead.
Asking 50,000 dollars—everyone thought it was ridiculous. A one-bedroom place, no matter how nicely decorated, wasn’t worth that much in resettlement housing.
So no one even looked at it anymore. Old man Bard grew anxious, searching for buyers everywhere. He’d even reached out to Arthur and privately discussed it with Ruth more than once.
Because the units were adjacent, all it would take was breaking through the corridor wall, and almost overnight, the living space would expand dramatically.
"Old man Bard is trying to rip me off. 50,000 dollars? He might as well rob me," Ruth said irritably. "At that rate, why don’t you try selling both floors of my unit instead?"
Aunt Kiara laughed scornfully. "Don’t talk nonsense. What kind of condition are your two units in? And what about old Bard’s? Besides, he’s now saying 45,000 dollars, taxes included."
In terms of livability, it was actually a pretty good deal. Bard’s apartment was just average to anyone else, but to Ruth, it was truly worth every penny.
Because once that upstairs corridor was opened up, what was once a awkward pseudo-duplex would instantly become a luxurious home.

Ruth didn’t have that kind of money, though. She brushed it off immediately: "45,000 is still too expensive. 40,000 would be more reasonable. Bard’s taste in decor isn’t that great anyway. He says it’s brand new and he spent a fortune, but that doesn’t mean everyone will like it."
"Then let me ask!"
Aunt Kiara’s eyes lit up, and she instantly grabbed her phone. Ruth didn’t even have time to stop her.

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Kiara, A Bitch
paragraphs: The defining feature of resettlement housing is that everyone knows each other’s backgrounds inside out. Most of the time, it’s extremely rare to see a stranger within the community, unless they’re new homeowners who have just moved in.
Everyone is well aware of Arthur’s circumstances—there’s no way he would spend money to buy a house for Ruth.

It’s true that both of these demolition compensation properties are under Ruth’s name, but as a housewife, her own financial situation is stretched to the limit. Where would she possibly get the money to buy things like a car or a house?

People are even clearer about Old man Bard’s situation. After his wife passed away, he became an absolute diamond bachelor, attracting the envy of widows all around. He was allocated several storefronts from the demolition, but held onto that particular apartment, hoping his son would return after finishing his studies so they could enjoy family happiness together.

As it turned out, his son made a good life for himself in a first-tier city—he had enough money to put a down payment on a home and married a wonderful woman. Both of them are highly educated, their lives are exceptionally stable, and they’re already preparing to try for a baby.
Old man Bard is burning with envy. He longs to hold his grandchild but doesn’t dare disturb the couple’s private world.

He bought a apartment right across from his son’s, hoping to share in that family joy. Over time, he sold off his storefronts one by one, and now only this one beautifully renovated apartment remains unsold.

Everyone marvels at that apartment—the materials used were extravagantly high-end, to the point where the cost exceeded the price of the property itself. Since Old man Bard is in the renovation business himself, how could he possibly use ordinary materials for his own son’s marital home?

After finishing her phone call, Aunt Kiara turned back with a smile and said, "Old man Bard agreed to sell it to you for 40,000 dollars, just as discussed before. He’ll cover the taxes and agency fees, and he can even have that wall knocked through for you within a single day."
Ruth was utterly stunned. "Is he that desperate for money?"
As a diamond bachelor wholly focused on earning money, Old man Bard is the dream man for every widow around here. The word "poverty" hardly seems applicable to him.

Aunt Kiara put on an ingratiating smile and said, "Old man Bard says he can’t sell the other plots of land, but this one he wants to offload quickly. His daughter-in-law is due to give birth soon, and he plans to buy a apartment for his grandson in a first-tier city."
"Sister Ruth, this is a good deal for both you and him. At this price, you’re absolutely getting a steal."

Aunt Kiara wasn’t wrong at all—the renovation of Old man Bard’s apartment is simply top-tier. A fortune was spent on both the hard and soft furnishings. If sold to anyone else, it might not stand out, but if sold to Ruth, once that corridor is opened up, the value will definitely increase.
"What, don’t tell me your son-in-law doesn’t have the money?"
Noticing Ruth’s hesitation, Aunt Kiara asked.
"Old man Bard said he only accepts full payment, no time for mortgage loans. Is it really that difficult? Didn’t you say your son-in-law is financially free now?"
Just as Ruth was feeling too embarrassed to answer, Luis happened to arrive—and of course, he hadn’t heard any of this conversation.
"Hello, sisters!
With that, Luis set the food on the table. The four-person meal purchased from Ocean World naturally wouldn’t let his Mother In Law lose face.
Lobster meatballs fried with black truffle, and the rest were pretty much all signature dishes. A conservative estimate for this delivered meal would be over a hundred dollars.

Luis didn’t plan to have lunch there either. Right after dropping off the food and about to leave, he was pulled back by Aunt Kiara. She briefly explained the situation and asked with a cheerful smile, "Second Son-in-law, let me talk to you about something."

Luis was also aware of that apartment they mentioned. It really was beautifully decorated—very tasteful and not tacky at all. His Mother In Law had been longing for it, even to the point of considering taking out a loan against her two current properties to buy that one.
But as a housewife, once she thought about all that loan interest, she gritted her teeth and gave up on the idea.
"That sounds pretty good actually!"
After listening, Luis said with a light laugh, "Mom, why don’t you call Lily over."
"Why should I call her over?"
"Our city has purchase restrictions. Lily’s quota should be saved for other investments, like a villa or a storefront. Let’s not use it on this, okay?"

Luis knew exactly what his Mother In Law’s situation was, and he played it cool with effortless ease. "Mom, you already have two properties under your name. Buying another would mean heavy taxes. So let’s put this one under Lily’s name for now. Just ask her, it should be fine."
"I—I’ll ask."
Ruth didn’t explain directly. She made a call and summoned a still somewhat confused Nancy to the Teahouse. At home, her authority as the fierce matriarch was not to be challenged.
Nancy’s arrival was as dazzling as ever. It has to be said, the elder sister’s charm remains stunningly breathtaking—what a shame she ended up married to that piece of shit Daniel.
Aunt Kiara voiced a note of doubt, "Old man Bard said he agreed to 40,000 dollars, but only for a full payment. Nothing else will do."
Luis casually pulled out a bank card and handed it to Nancy. "Sister, why don’t you go take care of it."
Aunt Kiara said excitedly, "Let’s go, then! Let’s go take a look."
"You all go ahead and see to it. Don’t let it interrupt my mom’s card game. It’s not that much money anyway."

This was showing off in the most effortless way. After handing over the card, Luis didn’t give it another thought. Instead, he looked at Nancy with total calm and said, "Sister, like we said before—40,000 dollars, not a cent more."
"Y—yes, I know!
Nancy’s feelings were complicated. She had woken up not knowing how to face her brother-in-law, but when she did wake up, Luis was already gone from the house.

She had gone to mediate a dispute the day before. Part of the reason her mother was so furious was that her card game had been interrupted. When asked about Luis, he very reluctantly said he had been called over just as he was exercising in the park.
Nancy believed it 100%—after all, her brother-in-law’s physique spoke for itself. Those unbelievably defined abs were incredibly attractive.
Most importantly, her brother-in-law doesn’t even go to the gym. Just the visual impact of those muscles alone—they’re clearly born of pure strength and are intensely alluring.
"Please handle this, sister. With purchase restrictions these days, everything’s such a hassle!"
"Live-in son-in-law, do you even have that much money on your card? Old man Bard is insisting on full payment."
Aunt Kiara suddenly piped up.
The moment Nancy took the card, she was filled with confidence. This was a card that could cover even the full price of a Cayenne—how could she let this bitch spout such nonsense?
"Aunt Kiara, you’re asking quite thoroughly whether we have money or not."

Nancy was the first to lose her temper. She said, "What, you think our family can’t afford to buy a house? We’ve already settled on a price, and now you come out with this—don’t you have anything better to do?"
"No, can’t I ask? 40,000 dollars is no small amount for your family."
Aunt Kiara shot back immediately.
Inside the Teahouse, this was already drawing attention. The meal itself had been eye-catching enough, and now with a sudden conflict breaking out, who wouldn’t want to watch the drama unfold?
"It is a not a large amount, to my brother-in-law, it’s not money."
Nancy’s confidence was so overwhelming that even Ruth was a little surprised, but then her Mother In Law was cut from the same cloth.
Ruth said impatiently, "Aunt Kiara, you’re talking too much nonsense. Are you selling it or not?"
"Selling, selling! Big sister, let’s go. I’ll contact Old man Bard to come over right now."
"Mom, I’ll be going too."
Luis also left first. Compared to his Mother In Law’s anxiety, Luis was completely at ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 132: Pervert, You Creep...
paragraphs: On Friday evening, when school ended at No. 1 High School, the entrance was still incredibly congested, though it was much better compared to the start of the school year and not as exaggerated. At least many students went home on their own.
After sending the location and license plate number to his sister in law, Luis started reading a book in the car.

After all, since he was now pretending to be a cultured person, Luis had bought a bunch of Language books. Not to mention that he was now completely proficient in English And Spanish, he found them quite interesting to read.
Language and dialect are actually quite similar. Only by understanding the special meanings behind words can one truly grasp the essence of language and culture.
After waiting a short while, the car door opened, and his sister in law directly sat in the passenger seat, smiling shyly and saying, "Brother, you came so early."
"I can’t keep my dear little baby waiting."
Luis reached out and touched her thigh, a lewd smile spreading across his face.

His sister in law was still wearing her school uniform, a loose sportswear style, but it couldn’t hide the curves of her chest. The petite and adorable sister in law now had an expression of pure shyness that was extremely alluring.
"Brother, is this the car you bought for my second sister?"
As soon as Leah got into the car, she tossed her schoolbag into the back and carefully examined the vehicle.
"It’s for your sister and mom to practice with."
Luis said casually.
Leah knew nothing about cars, but a sedan was a luxury item for her family.
"Where’s Avery? Why isn’t she with you? I can drop her off on the way."
Luis couldn’t help but ask.
Avery and his sister in law were like conjoined twins. It was strange that they went their separate ways after school.
"She asked for leave this afternoon. She said her grandmother’s birthday banquet is today, so she had to go back to her hometown early.
Leah glanced at the back seat, stuck out her tongue, and said, "Brother, there are so many books. Can you finish them all?"
"I read them when I have free time, baby..."

Luis suddenly leaned toward her. The sister in law immediately felt a bit shy. Seeing the classmates and parents coming and going outside, she hid embarrassedly and said, "Brother, what, what are you trying to do?"
Luis’s hand was clearly moving toward her chest. Leah instinctively protected her chest with both hands, her face flushed bright red, looking utterly adorable.

However, Luis did not grope her breasts. Instead, he pulled over the seatbelt and teased her, "Baby, if I wanted to take advantage of you, I’d do it at home. Your brother wouldn’t be so bold out here in front of everyone."
"Be good, let go of your hands. Brother will help you fasten your seatbelt."
"Stinky brother, you pervert."
Leah realized she had been teased. She gave him a tender, reproachful glance, obediently let go of her hands, and watched with embarrassment as her brother pulled the seatbelt across her chest.
The school uniform was originally very loose, but the seatbelt immediately accentuated a deep cleavage, making the uniform cling tightly to her body.

The outline of her right breast was round and enticing. She looked pure and innocent, yet so surprisingly well endowed that it made one’s mouth water just imagining such large assets on her petite frame.

After fastening her seatbelt, Luis did not do anything inappropriate. After all, with people coming and going outside the car, it wasn’t the right place to take major liberties. If he made his sister in law angry, it wouldn’t be worth it.

Blushing, Leah said coquettishly, "Stinky brother, serves you right for teasing me."
"Hehe, so teasing my baby Leah comes with a reward. That’s great. I should’ve touched you earlier."
Luis grinned pervertedly, licked the teeth marks on his hand, and savored his sister in law’s saliva with relish.
"Pervert brother, you total creep."

After returning home, Luis casually placed the books he brought in the living room. When Leah went back to her room, she felt a bit disgusted. After all, it was the first time she had her own boudoir.
She had chosen all the furniture and the bed herself, but her eldest sister had ended up sleeping in it for several days in a row.
Nancy was not a diligent person. While his sister in law complained about this smell and that, she immediately changed the bedsheets and quilt covers, looking thoroughly displeased.

The whole family gathered around dinnertime. Nancy already had the keys that Old Bard had left with Aunt Kiara. She said rather proudly, "Mom, the money was transferred to the escrow account this afternoon. I just need to go to the property center with Old Bard tomorrow morning to complete the transfer."
Except for Luis, the entire family was in a daze, including Ruth, who had started the whole thing.
She had only blurted it out in the heat of the moment, but Luis spent 40,000 dollars to buy the house, making the decision almost instantly. He wasn’t even that casual when buying groceries.
"It’s so beautiful here."

The decoration of Old Bard’s apartment was truly impressive, and the layout was better than the Whitmore family’s house. Although the master bedroom was empty, it was stylishly decorated and came with a walk in closet, which was very nice.
Nancy said, "Old Bard mentioned that the decoration here is good, but if our family needs any modifications, he can help and just charge us for the labor."
Old Bard had all the floor plans. Because the area of the duplex’s second floor was larger, there was actually no need for a small living room and that pocket sized kitchen.

The decoration was so well done that there was no need for major renovations. The small living room could be converted into a storage room with cabinets on both sides, connected to the large balcony, making it a perfect place for drying clothes.

As for the kitchen, they could seal the wall and connect the kitchen and bathroom. They could place a bathtub there, making it more convenient to bathe the baby in the future. The area would also be larger and not as cramped as before.
"What about the original bathroom?"
"Just keep it. When the time comes, convert it into a storage room. It’ll be perfect for storing seasonal items."
As soon as Luis spoke, almost none of the four Wood family mother and daughters objected. Subconsciously, they had already begun to see Luis as the head of the household.
Looking at these four stunningly beautiful mother and daughters, Luis instinctively swallowed and thought to himself that if things continued to develop this way, this family would become his harem.

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Heading To Chloe Home
paragraphs: We had dinner outside without buying any groceries. Originally, the pregnant woman should have been the one to decide, but now Lily’s status in the family has risen significantly.
However, when she suggested eating the boxed meals from downstairs, her elder and younger sisters-in-law instantly exploded.

Nancy spoke first, "Lily, I’m begging you. You’re not just thinking about yourself now, but also the baby in your belly. Eating boxed meals??? We promised Mom and your husband that we wouldn’t allow it."
Even Leah chimed in with a condescending tone, "That’s right, Second Sister, I beg you to stop being so stingy."
Luis also joined in, "Wife, Leah comes home once a week to satisfy her cravings. What’s the difference between you eating a boxed meal like this and her eating in the cafeteria?"
"Then, let’s have barbecue!"
He drove his scooter to a very famous Korean barbecue restaurant and ordered some relatively expensive cuts of meat.
"By the way, Brother-in-law, why is the house you bought under Eldest Sister’s name?"
Leah was full of confusion.
In fact, Nancy’s thoughts were equally strange. If her own husband bought a house and said he would put it under her sister’s name, Nancy felt she would go crazy.
"Purchase restrictions!"
Luis said affectionately, "When a contract expires in the second half of the year, I’ll buy your Second Sister a nicer house or a villa. That way, the taxes will be more cost-effective."
Nancy pretended to be unhappy and said, "Wouldn’t that put me at a big disadvantage when I buy a house in the future?"
"I’ll subsidize Eldest Sister then."
After Luis said this, Lily was no longer confused. She smiled sweetly and placed a piece of barbecue in Luis’s bowl.

Ruth also spoke approvingly at this point, "Little Sister, why are you asking so many questions? The house was bought for all of us to live in together. Your Brother-in-law’s money isn’t being spent on vixens outside. Your Second Sister has no objections, so why are you so talkative?"
"Just curious!"
Leah stuck out her tongue embarrassedly, looking very cute.
Luis couldn’t help but glance at his Mother-in-law, thinking lustfully in his heart that no vixen outside could be as enticing as the ones at home.

Ruth felt a little embarrassed under his malicious gaze and seemed to instantly understand what her son-in-law meant. She thoughtfully looked at her tall, sexy eldest daughter and her youthful, big-breasted youngest daughter.
Leah was much more lively now, and her little mouth wouldn’t stop, "Second Sister, why do you still want to buy a house? Our home is big enough for all of us. Do you still want to move out?"
This was a soul-searching question for her. For Luis, he had never wanted to stay in this house for even a moment.
Lily felt the same way. Her family looked down on her husband, and she wanted to enjoy being the hostess and the beauty of having her own world.
Not to mention buying a house, Lily was even considering renting one.
Lily blushed and said, "It’s just not convenient living at home."
"What’s inconvenient about it!"
Ruth’s voice rose when she heard this, "You little girl, have you grown wings or something?"
"Mom, look, Eldest Sister is living here again now, and Little Sister is still a child. I have to consider their feelings too."
Lily immediately found a perfect excuse, "Luis is most afraid of the heat and is used to wearing just his underwear for comfort. How inconvenient would that be..."
This time, before Ruth could even speak, Nancy rolled her eyes charmingly and said, "What’s so inconvenient about it? It’s better to be more casual in your own home."
"That’s right, Second Sister, you’re overthinking it."
Leah also chimed in.
Ruth even said, "What’s wrong? You don’t want to be a live-in son-in-law anymore? You don’t want to be with Mom? You think Mom is old and an eyesore, is that it?"
"Mom, I didn’t mean that!"
Lily’s face immediately turned red.

Luis quickly came to the rescue, saying, "Mom, don’t overthink it. Every young couple wants to live a shameless life together. But let’s put that idea aside for now. Lily is pregnant and needs someone to take care of her."

Ruth then said with a smile, "Your sister will only stay for a little while, and your younger sister will be at school most of the time. Don’t worry, I have good judgment and will do my best not to disturb your love life."
"But you can’t go too far in your current condition."
Nancy nodded shyly. Actually, after she got pregnant, her desire to move out wasn’t as strong.

Mainly because her husband was now the head of the household, and her mother and sister’s attitudes had changed drastically. She also enjoyed this sense of vanity. For her, it was a new and wonderful experience.
After dinner, Luis gave the car keys to Nancy and asked her to drive the family back home. In the evening, she could also take his Mother-in-law out for driving practice.
After they left, Luis took out his phone. The first thing he saw was a friend request with a cute cartoon avatar and the note "Rococo.
Luis naturally remembered this elf-like, pretty girl and immediately accepted the friend request, though she didn’t send any message.
The main reason was that Chloe sent a message and asked, "Do you really want to support me?"
Luis called directly. It took a while for the other end to answer, and the voice was soft. "Are you done?"
"What’s going on?"
Luis asked directly, "Even if it’s about keeping someone, we should sit down and talk face to face. Why are you asking this all of a sudden? Just tell me what’s going on."
Luis guessed correctly. There must be a special situation for Chloe to ask such a question.

After a moment of silence, Chloe on the other end of the phone said softly, "Anglo asked me to come over today, but I said I was busy. He threatened me that if I didn’t come over tomorrow, he would formally sue me and then tell my family about what happened between you and me last night."
"He touched me before, but I refused. Now he’s threatening me again. I don’t know what to do."
"He was so impatient today because he knew I had already done it once and wanted me to serve him."
It was self-evident what Anglo asked her to do. It was definitely not as simple as a heart to heart talk.
"Where are you? I want to see you."
Chloe said helplessly.
"Is your child asleep?"
Chloe hesitated for a moment and said, "My mother is out for something. Why don’t you come over? I’m worried about the child being left alone."
"Good."

Although it was ridiculous, she still gave her home address to her first cheating partner and her first client, which shows that the tenderness Luis showed her last night had already shaken her heart.
Because of money, the stunningly beautiful wife who turned to prostitution actually lived in a high-end residential community on Hailton Road.
After registering at the entrance and having the security guard confirm with the homeowner, Luis rang the doorbell according to the house number she provided.

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Hela And Chloe Are Sisters
paragraphs: The charming wife shyly opened the door.
"Come in!"

Chloe wore a conservative maternity nightgown that concealed her graceful curves. Even without makeup at home, she still looked exceptionally delicate and lovely. Her hair was tied up, giving her a virtuous appearance.
She handed Luis a pair of slippers and cautiously glanced outside before closing the door.
Luis casually sat on the sofa. Seeing her apparent unease, he directly took her hand, and Chloe settled into Luis’s lap.
The distressed wife sighed and leaned into the arms of this unfamiliar man, trembling nervously as she said, "Luis, what should I do? If he... if he exposes all this, I’m finished."
As she spoke, Chloe trembled uncontrollably, tears already streaming down her face. Biting her silver teeth, her expression—filled with both hatred and helplessness—was utterly heartbreaking.
"Don’t be foolish. He absolutely wouldn’t dare."
Luis held her close, gently kissing away her tears while soothing her. "If he really dared, even one report to the police would land him in jail. That bastard is purely trying to intimidate you."
Luis thought to himself that a few chat logs alone proved nothing. Leem had probably deleted them for his own safety.
If she was afraid of ruin, then the video in Nancy’s hands was the truly fatal thing.
"He really wouldn’t dare?"
"Really."
Chloe, tears streaming down like rain, wept in Luis’s arms. Seizing the moment would be inappropriate, so Luis simply held her, offering comfort and allowing her to fully release her emotions.
Just as her tears began to subside, a child’s cry suddenly came from the bedroom.
A mother’s strength emerges in adversity. The pitifully weeping Chloe immediately wiped away her tears and hurried into the bedroom.

Luis took a closer look: it was a two-bedroom apartment, nearly 100 square meters—quite spacious. The decor was noticeably new, clearly a bridal chamber, with many large red "double happiness" characters still visible.
The thought of having an affair in someone else’s new home filled Luis with wicked ideas. Unable to sit still, he followed her into the master bedroom.

The master bedroom was spacious and warmly decorated, adorned with prominent "double happiness" characters that created a cozy and romantic atmosphere. Most notably, a huge wedding photo hung above the bed.
In the wedding photo, Chloe’s face radiated warmth and happiness as she leaned against her husband.

Her husband was somewhat older, gentle and refined in appearance, exuding an air of sophistication. Dressed in a suit and wearing gold-rimmed glasses, he looked every bit the successful man, proudly holding his young wife.
Chloe also noticed the footsteps, her face slightly flushed, but she said nothing.
In the crib lay a crying baby girl, seemingly less than a year old. Chloe sat on the edge of the bed, picked up the child, and after a moment of hesitation, pulled down one strap of her dress.
The design of this dress allowed for easy breastfeeding. A full, enticing breast swayed into view. Chloe carefully wiped her nipple with a wet wipe before placing it into her daughter’s mouth.
The moment the baby began to nurse, she stopped crying, sucking contentedly at her mother’s nipple.
Luis watched with burning eyes, breathing heavily. "Your milk supply is plentiful. The little one seems to be enjoying it."
"I produce a lot of milk..."
Chloe was utterly embarrassed but still replied.
A stranger—even her client—was now standing beside her, witnessing her most maternal moment. This was an intimacy that breached her privacy in the most profound way.
At that moment, Luis moved closer and wrapped his arms around her waist. Chloe shuddered, pleading weakly, "No... don’t do anything. Let me finish feeding her first, okay?"
"Alright!"
Luis felt both nervous and excited. Glancing at their wedding photo, he asked, "What does your husband do?"
"Don’t even ask!"
Chloe seemed to recall something sorrowful and sighed. Seeing her reluctance to elaborate, Luis didn’t press further. It appeared something had happened in her family.
Gazing at the pitifully beautiful wife before him, the snow-white expanse of her chest was irresistibly alluring. Luis couldn’t help but frivolously lift her chin with his finger.
Chloe looked over in shame. Luis gazed at her tenderly and gently kissed her. This time, Chloe didn’t resist.
Luis softly kissed her lips, slowly coaxing her to part her cherry-like mouth before boldly capturing her delicate tongue and sucking on it.
Chloe closed her eyes, her tongue responding hesitantly. Even when Luis undid the other strap of her dress, she offered no objection.
But just then, the doorbell rang, startling them both. Chloe hurriedly said, "That’s strange. My mother shouldn’t be back this early."
Luis instinctively asked, "Your mother?"
"I’m not sure. She shouldn’t be back at this hour."

At that moment, who it was didn’t matter. A strange man in the house would unequivocally mean being caught in the act—especially during something as private as breastfeeding, which even one’s own father would avoid.
"You... hide in the closet."
Both were panicked. Under her direction, Luis immediately hid in the closet.
His heart raced with anxiety, wondering if he was just that unlucky—getting caught the very first time he indulged in the thrill of an affair.
Chloe adjusted her dress straps and walked out, carrying the still-hungry, crying child.
"Who is it?"
"Chloe, it’s me."
"Sister, what are you doing here?"
Luis froze upon hearing this. The visitor was Daniel’s mother, his target for the dungeon strategy—the haughty Hela.
Hela walked in and went straight to the bedroom. Chloe was too embarrassed to stop her and followed her quickly.
Hela sat in the bedroom, looked at her sister’s child and said casually, "Feed the child first."
Obviously, in front of her powerful aura, Chloe was a little at a loss. She glanced secretly in the direction of the wardrobe, put down the sling again and started feeding the child.

Winslet wore a pair of gold-rimmed glasses, her hair naturally tied up, giving her a dignified charm. She wasn’t a peerless beauty, but she was definitely a beautiful young woman.
"Little Luis has become so handsome."
Winslet was also stunned when she saw Luis, but she smiled after sitting down.
"Not at all, Master’s Wife is the most stunning and charming. I hardly dare recognize you."
Luis’s words weren’t just flattery. Although he had contact with his master’s wife when he was apprenticed to Fatty, Winslet was busy studying for exams at the time.
She wore men’s clothes every day. To say she looked unkempt might be a bit exaggerated, but she definitely didn’t wear makeup and was somewhat disheveled.

Back then, she wore black-framed glasses with lenses as thick as the bottom of a beer bottle, slightly twisted. Although it was obvious she had good features, she looked like a nerdy bookworm gone mad.
And now Winslet had transformed. With a little makeup, she had become a Legally Blonde. With a short skirt, black stockings, and gold-rimmed glasses, she was full of charm.
"So you’re saying I was ugly before? Do you suspect I had plastic surgery?"
Winslet looked displeased.
"My master’s wife is naturally beautiful. How could she possibly need plastic surgery?"
Luis joked, "I was just thinking how someone like my master could possibly deserve you. Other people’s ancestral graves emit smoke, but his family’s grave must have exploded."
Winslet’s smile stiffened slightly, as if she didn’t want to mention Fatty.
After taking a sip of coffee, she said softly, "You little brat, you definitely wouldn’t think of me if nothing was wrong. Tell me, what difficulties have you run into?"
"As long as you don’t borrow money, our mother-son relationship will remain strong."

Luis knew she was very busy today, so he didn’t beat around the bush and explained his sister-in-law’s situation. Actually, Chloe’s situation was similar, so there was no need to go into too much detail.
"That’s it? I know about Nova Media. Another lawyer has taken on the case."

Winslet crossed her legs, sipped her coffee, and said with a disdainful smile, "The so-called lawyer in their company is just a junior lawyer who just got his license. There are problems with how the contract was drafted."
"If you run into someone stubborn, just hire a lawyer to fight them. It’ll drag on endlessly, and they won’t end up paying a dime."
Luis’s eyes lit up when he heard this: "So this lawsuit isn’t difficult at all?"
Winslet laughed and said, "What do you think? I can just find an assistant to beat him half to death. He can only scare those who know nothing."
"A lawyer’s letter is just a piece of trash. I can’t guarantee I’ll win if I sue you. There are always so many bizarre lawsuits I can’t even begin to describe them all."
"Master’s Wife, do you mean that if you step in, this matter can be resolved?"
"It’s not a big deal. Generally, a junior lawyer would be willing to take it. There’s no need for me to get involved."
Winslet asked with concern, "Was your wife cheated? If so, I will step in personally, and we can sue to annoy them."
"No, no, it’s my sister-in-law and a friend of mine."
"Well, well... you kid."
Winslet narrowed her eyes and said with an ambiguous smile, "I admire your maturity at such a young age the most. You’re even steadier than your master and never meddle in other people’s business."
"Forget about my sister-in-law, there’s another woman. Be honest, what’s the relationship?
Seeing her smile like that, Luis didn’t feel comfortable hiding it, so he scratched his head and said, "There’s some emotional involvement."
"My precious son has grown up, gotten married, and even has a lover. He’s learned bad things too."
Winslet frowned slightly at first, seeming very dissatisfied with Luis’s behavior. After all, she knew Luis was married and was acquainted with Lily.
Winslet also admired Lily very much, saying she was a model of marrying a virtuous wife. She kept praising Luis for his luck, saying even as a live-in son-in-law, having such a wife was a blessing.
Luis noticed she was a bit upset and immediately said timidly, "Master’s wife, I wouldn’t want to deceive anyone else, but especially not you. Please don’t be angry, alright?"
Hearing this, Winslet’s expression softened considerably. Upon closer thought, it made sense—mainly, she was just surprised that Luis had admitted everything so readily.

Her husband’s apprentice wasn’t related to her by blood, yet he had always shown her immense respect. Whenever there was a holiday, if he had time, he would definitely bring gifts to visit; if not, he would at least call.
Thinking this, Winslet’s tone returned to its gentle warmth: "I just didn’t expect you, you little rascal, to be so charming."
"Not really!"
Luis scratched his head sheepishly and said, "It’s mainly because Master’s Wife asked—I didn’t dare lie!"
"You’re a sensible boy after all."
Winslet checked the time, thought for a moment, and said, "Alright, tonight, bring them and the contract to my office and explain the situation clearly to my assistant."
"Keep a copy of the contract. I’ll handle the specifics."
"Then don’t worry about this lawsuit anymore. These kinds of nuisance lawsuits are just about who can outlast whom. Once the documents are organized, I’ll send him a lawyer’s letter first."
Winslet let out a cold, authoritative laugh: "Whether the court will even accept such a sham contract is another matter. Who does he think he’s trying to intimidate?"

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Daniel Is Infertile
paragraphs: "Master’s wife, what about the legal fees?"
"Enough of that, I am a wealthy woman. I don’t need your money."
Winslet giggled, stood up, and said, "If it were an outsider, I’d charge the standard rate. But since one is your sister-in-law and the other is your little lover, I’ll take this on personally."
"Thank you, Master’s Wife!"
Luis called Chloe first. Her mother-in-law had just returned home.

Luis drove straight to pick her up. Chloe sat in the passenger seat, holding her sleeping child. Without a safety seat, Luis glanced at the beautiful wife beside him, his heart itching with desire but he restrained himself from making any moves.
After finishing the errand, Luis dropped her off downstairs. Chloe held the child, her face soft and tender: "Do you want to come up? I’ll cook for you."
"Not today. Let’s wait a few days. I’ll get this sorted out for you first."
"Alright, here’s the key to my place..."
Blushing, Chloe handed him a key, kissed him on the cheek, and whispered temptingly, "Come over whenever you want, even in the dead of night."
"You little temptress, just you wait—next time, I’m going to make your milk spray everywhere!"
Luis couldn’t afford to be idle. He headed home and picked up his sister-in-law Nancy, who was waiting by the roadside.
Nancy was dressed as provocatively as ever today. The moment she settled into the passenger seat, her expression shifted. Gritting her teeth, she said, "You went to see Chloe, didn’t you?"
"How did you know??"
Luis was taken aback. How had she found out?
Nancy took out a tissue and wiped his face. When she unfolded it, the distinct red mark was unmistakably lipstick.

The elder sister-in-law said, half-amused, half-exasperated, "If you’re going to sneak around, can’t you be more careful? Lily never wears lipstick—and now that she’s pregnant, she’s not buying any makeup at all. If she finds out, who are you going to say kissed you?"
It was only then that Luis remembered—Chloe had worn light makeup today, clearly having dressed up nicely hoping to get laid, though he hadn’t been able to enjoy it.
"Just say my elder sister kissed me."
"I’ll smash your brains out with a hammer."
In the car, Nancy couldn’t resist probing for details. Luis didn’t elaborate much, only saying he planned to support Chloe for a while and had helped her find a lawyer to handle the lawsuit.
"My master’s wife said that having one more person involved means more perspectives, which will help handle things more smoothly. She’s benefiting from your connection, elder sister."
Hearing this, Nancy felt much more satisfied. After a moment’s thought, she couldn’t help asking, "Brother-in-law, what... terms did you agree on with her?"
Luis knew full well she was buried in debt—he’d said all this precisely to provoke her. Casually, he replied:
"Chloe’s family ran into trouble. She owed nearly 10,000 dollars. I gave her 20,000 dollars."
"Twenty thousand dollars?? And how long are you supporting her for?"
Nancy’s gaze grew distant.
Twenty thousand dollars... with that kind of money, she could solve all her problems.

She’d gone to finalize the house transfer that morning and was just waiting for the documents to be processed. When she returned, Nancy couldn’t resist checking the balance—the card that once held 10,000 dollars now had only 6,000 left.
All day, her mind had been in turmoil.
Should she ask her brother-in-law for a loan? It would be humiliating, but her situation was desperate. What if he refused? Maybe she should just withdraw the money first and ask forgiveness later?
In the end, Nancy couldn’t bring herself to do it and returned the card to Luis untouched.
Driving, Luis said playfully, "We didn’t discuss the details, but it’ll probably last until after Lily gives birth. She’s already given me the keys to her place."
"You shameless man!"
Nancy couldn’t hold back: "Brother-in-law, you’re going too far. I get it if you just want to have some fun—even I can understand that—but why would you spend so much money to support her?"
A thought began stirring restlessly in Nancy’s mind, though it felt utterly absurd.

"Elder sister, I’m glad you understand. Lily’s only been pregnant a few months, and my needs are... considerable. I have to find some way to cope, right? Besides, you’re the one who introduced me to her."
Luis spoke righteously, though his logic felt a bit forced.

The video he’d sent that morning had gone unanswered by all three of them—their unified silence was almost amusing. But after spending this much time together, they’d probably realized Lily couldn’t satisfy his sexual appetite.
"Then you could’ve just found other women. Why support her properly?"
A sense of unease began creeping into Nancy’s heart.
Although all this was accomplished with her instigation, Nancy became more and more scared the more she thought about it.
One is her younger sister’s husband, her brother-in-law, and the other is her husband’s aunt, the absolute elder in name.
If it was just an ordinary affair, she could even condemn it from a moral high ground, but now she was the one who caused it all.

Even seeing how loving her sister and brother-in-law were, Nancy once felt that without her encouragement, Luis, her honest brother-in-law, would not have cheated on her. For a time, she felt extremely guilty.
Was she too crazy? When they met, would Chloe go crazy when she knew the identity of her client?
Did the brother-in-law support her because this identity was exciting, or was it because of Chloe’s flirtatious behavior that night...
Nancy was lost in thought when they finally arrived at their destination.
On one side of the office, Nancy temporarily stopped herself from thinking about random things and focused on talking to her assistant about the situation she had encountered.
Luis sat aside drinking tea and opened the System interface when he had nothing to do.
Sister-in-law Nancy: favorability meter 55%...
The favorability is still a bit low. Luis couldn’t help but frown, but continued reading.
The information in the Know-It-All skill has been updated. The collection of big data has been ongoing, and a lot of useful information has been added.

The results of the genetic test showed that she did have the same homosexual genes as her wife. Her physical senses were not affected at the moment, but under the influence of emotions, these genes began to show signs of activation.
The newly added data should have been collected by the hospital. Luis was too lazy to look at the pile of examination and test reports.
The diagnosis was: abnormal blockage of the fallopian tube (commonly known as infertility).
What’s even more interesting is that this skill can also collect information about other people related to her:

Her brother-in-law Daniel also had a lot of test results, and the results showed that he had a series of diseases including prostate hyperplasia, nephritis, vas deferens inflammation, hyperuricemia, etc.
The most obvious problem is the lack of sperm activity (close to infertility), which can be treated but is difficult, time-consuming and has a low success rate.
This couple is interesting. One is infertile and the other is sterile, but they are really a perfect match.

The key point is that Daniel has some self-awareness. He feels that he has not had enough of eating, drinking and having fun and does not want to be a father and work hard. Now it seems that he is using this to cover up the many problems that have drained his body away due to alcohol and sex.
The data is still being loaded. The System is very intelligent and probably only the information that is useful to you is filtered out.
After taking Nancy to deal with this matter, Luis thought about sending her back first, and he felt itchy in his heart that he would go to Chloe’s house to spend the night.
Nancy seemed to see through Luis’s thoughts. She snorted unhappily and said, "Are you going to Chloe’s place tonight?"
"No, I have to go to the internet cafe to do something tonight."
Seeing that she was in a bad mood, Luis made an excuse.

With this level of favorability, there is no question of being jealous, and Luis is not narcissistic enough to that extent. Seeing Nancy’s big reaction, Luis knew that these stimuli had a positive effect.
After asking over the phone, Lily happened to be at home. Luis smiled and said, "There’s still time. Why don’t you accompany Lily to learn how to drive?"
"Why don’t you teach your wife yourself?"
"Please, big sister, I will definitely repay you handsomely in the future."
"That’s more like it."
Luis emphasized the word "repay" particularly hard. Nancy agreed at first but then realized what was happening. She gave Luis a fierce look and her face turned slightly red.
His wife Lily and elder sister went to practice driving. Luis thought for a moment and ran back home with a smile in his eyes. It was rare that his sister-in-law was left alone.
You should know that among the several targets, Luis is the least anxious about his mother-in-law because they live under the same roof, while his sister-in-law only comes back once a week.
Time is precious, and it is very suitable for completing a task so that the System has enough time to generate the next task.
Compared to a beautiful wife, the temptation of completing the task is obviously stronger.
Like a thief, Luis tiptoed upstairs and found his sister-in-law’s door ajar.
Luis took a quick look and saw his sister-in-law on the bed with a cute ponytail, wearing only a pair of pink panties and a thin tank top, obviously not wearing a bra.

"Buying a crappy phone and thinking they’re rich.
All three of them are dressed in cheap stuff."
Ojhaka also mocked them, deliberately showing off her bag: "Godfather bought this bag last time, but it’s a bit outdated now.
Here to buy a new one.
Not like the cheap stuff you carry."
As she said this, Ojhaka felt a dull pain in her anus.
The price of a new bag was having her back door forced open twice last night.
She still couldn’t walk properly.
She also sensed the fat man was getting tired of her, constantly urging her to find new women for him to play with.
A pedophilic pervert... but just thinking about the new bag she was about to get, Ojhaka felt her spirits lift again.
"Brother-in-law, ignore her!"
Leah was the first to back down, tugging at him and saying, "I’m hungry.
Let’s go eat something."
